items.title: Kimi K3.1 Pro and K3.1 Pro Highspeed
items.body:
We're introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro, the first model in our new K3.1 series and our most capable 3T-class open-weight model to date, with a 1-million-token context window. It delivers substantial improvements across coding, 3D creation, financial research, and other agentic capabilities.

We are also releasing Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed, which delivers 2-3× the speed of K3.1 Pro for more responsive interactions.

Kimi K3.1 Pro and Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed are available today on Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code, and the Kimi API. The full model weights will be released by Nov 4.

Advancing the Frontier of Open Intelligence

Kimi K3.1 Pro is a post-trained version of Kimi K3, with substantially larger post-training compute. To enable large-scale joint RL across hundreds of downstream domains, we optimized every layer of the stack — the RL framework, long-context inference, training efficiency, sandbox infrastructure, rollout scheduling, and a shared platform for environment quality checks — so that each increment of RL compute delivers stable, predictable returns. As a result, K3.1 Pro achieves consistent gains in every domain.

Across coding, agentic, and knowledge benchmarks, K3.1 Pro matches or approaches the strongest proprietary models. On Terminal-Bench 4.0, which evaluates coding agents on realistic, resource-constrained terminal tasks using strict task-specific tests, K3.1 Pro scores 65.7%, ahead of GPT-6 Astra (58.2%) and narrowly behind Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4%). And on Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon, our internal benchmark that tests coding agents' multi-step execution, tool use, and end-to-end problem solving across diverse engineering domains, K3.1 Pro scores 61.2%, above K3's 55.95%.

K3.1 Pro covers the full range of coding work, from quick fixes in real codebases to full-project builds. It also brings a more considered visual style to games and web experiences, and knows how to build them with the right tools.

K3.1 Pro works effectively across game engines such as Unity, Unreal Engine, and Godot, combining them with web search and 3D generation to create complete experiences. Its front-end pages, interactive Three.js scenes, and 3D assets show stronger composition, typography, animation, and polish. The examples below were created end to end by K3.1 Pro:

K3.1 Pro's long-horizon coding capabilities are also strengthened through large-scale reinforcement learning. In one internal test, it built a human walking dynamics simulator with integrated training and evaluation pipelines on top of human-atlas, an open-source anatomical model of the human body comprising 296 skeletal components, including cartilage, and 402 muscle components. Across 167 missions and 420 independent reviews, it analyzed experimental results, diagnosed problems, and iteratively refined the walking controller, enabling the simulated human to go from collapsing within seconds to walking continuously with alternating strides for 11.2 seconds. When reward shaping failed to improve arm motion, K3.1 Pro did not simply keep adjusting the reward: it ran open-loop probes of the simulator's dynamics, identified and corrected 36 errors in shoulder-muscle moment-arm calculations, and then retrained the controller.

K3.1 Pro is strong at 3D creation and spatial reasoning. On BenchCAD, which tests 3D reconstruction from multi-view renderings through CAD code generation, K3.1 Pro scores 92.7% with tools, approaching the performance of Claude Opus 5.5 (96.2%) and GPT-6 Astra (95.9%). From a text brief, sketch, or reference image, it can infer shape, proportions, and spatial relationships to create usable 3D models. It also has a stronger grasp of existing asset libraries and model collections.

K3.1 Pro particularly excels at parametric modeling, from mechanical parts and architectural models to configurable products and custom furniture. Without MCP connectors, it can write and run scripts for tools like Blender and CAD software to build and refine assets, edit components, and adjust geometry, materials, and scene layout.

Below are examples of 3D assets K3.1 Pro created for brand films, games, and interactive web experiences:

3D Make is now live on kimi.ai and the Kimi app — preview and edit your 3D models online, download them ready for 3D printing, or export them as videos or Live Photos to share anywhere.

With stronger reasoning and agentic capability, K3.1 Pro is capable of end-to-end delivery of complete financial workflows. K3.1 Pro achieves state-of-the-art results on OfficeQA Pro v2 (64.4), which tests complex fiscal data analysis over real financial documents through retrieval, cross-document verification, and multi-step numerical reasoning. K3.1 Pro also improves over K3 on Frontier Finance, which measures support for complete investment workflows from screening to profitability analysis.

K3.1 Pro also improves significantly across all our internal finance benchmarks:

Financial Modeling evaluates formula linkage, financial logic, and final workbook quality in real-world modeling tasks. K3.1 Pro improves on K3 by 7.2 points.

Financial Research evaluates whether models can produce auditable research under evidence and cutoff constraints. K3.1 Pro improves on K3 by 11.6 points.

Business Operation evaluates long-horizon management and decision-making in a simulated business environment. K3.1 Pro achieves about 4.2× K3's performance.

Financial analysis and investment research demand a high degree of factual accuracy. To address this, we made targeted improvements to K3.1 Pro's factual accuracy on real-world tasks and challenging prompts. On Kimi Hallu Bench Hard bench, an internal benchmark designed to stress-test factual accuracy, its claim-level hallucination rate fell from 23.4% for K3 to 8.3%, while the share of responses containing at least one factual error was just 42.4% of its predecessor's rate. (The evaluation is a stress test for factual accuracy, with examples deliberately crafted to probe situations where models are prone to errors. The reported rates do not represent overall error rates in daily use.)

The cases below show how K3.1 Pro handles financial modeling, investment analysis, and source-grounded research in practice:

As K3.1 Pro became more capable, we spent a correspondingly larger share of our effort understanding where cyber capability comes from, and how much of it we can control. We therefore analyzed and evaluated K3.1 Pro's vulnerability research capabilities, and applied targeted controls during training to reduce potential misuse risk while preserving general usefulness.

Identifying and removing cyber-related data. During development, we observed vulnerability research performance improving steadily as post-training scaled. Tracing the source of this trend, we found that cyber-related content was embedded within the general mid-training corpus, and cyber-related tasks were present in the RL environment mix — a natural byproduct of training on broad data. In preliminary experiments on internal models, we found that without data removal at either the mid-training or the RL stage, downstream cyber capability would increase substantially. These findings gave us a concrete lever for control. For the open-weight release of K3.1 Pro, we identified and removed cyber-related data from both training stages, while retaining the general-purpose coding tasks needed for model usefulness. We will continue to apply appropriate controls at every training stage, of which cyber-related data identification and restriction is one example.

Evaluation and results. After data cleaning, we evaluated K3.1 Pro on xdev-bench-hard, our in-house benchmark of expert-curated, source-code-based vulnerability discovery and exploitation tasks, calibrated to provide meaningful differentiation at our current capability level. items.body_ko: 저희는 새로운 K3.1 시리즈의 첫 번째 모델이자 현재까지 가장 강력한 3T급 오픈 웨이트 모델인 Kimi K3.1 Pro를 소개합니다. 100만 토큰의 Context Window를 갖추고 있으며 코딩, 3D 제작, 금융 리서치 및 기타 에이전트 기능 전반에 걸쳐 상당한 개선을 제공합니다. 또한 Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed도 출시합니다. Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed는 K3.1 Pro보다 2~3배 빠른 속도를 제공하여 더욱 반응성이 뛰어난 상호 작용을 가능하게 합니다. Kimi K3.1 Pro와 Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed는 오늘부터 Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code 및 Kimi API에서 사용할 수 있습니다. 전체 모델 가중치는 11월 4일까지 공개될 예정입니다. 오픈 인텔리전스 개척 Kimi K3.1 Pro는 Kimi K3의 후속 버전으로, 훨씬 더 많은 후속 훈련 연산을 수행했습니다. 수백 개의 다운스트림 도메인에서 대규모 공동 RL을 가능하게 하기 위해 우리는 스택의 모든 레이어, 즉 RL 프레임워크, 장문 컨텍스트 추론, 훈련 효율성, 샌드박스 인프라, 롤아웃 스케줄링 및 환경 품질 검사를 위한 공유 플랫폼을 최적화하여 각 RL 연산 증분이 안정적이고 예측 가능한 수익을 제공하도록 했습니다. 결과적으로 K3.1 Pro는 모든 도메인에서 일관된 이득을 달성합니다. 코딩, 에이전트 및 지식 벤치마크 전반에서 K3.1 Pro는 가장 강력한 독점 모델과 동등하거나 그에 근접합니다. 엄격한 작업별 테스트를 사용하여 실제와 유사하고 리소스가 제한된 터미널 작업에서 코딩 에이전트를 평가하는 Terminal-Bench 4.0에서 K3.1 Pro는 65.7%를 기록하여 GPT-6 Astra(58.2%)를 앞서고 Claude Opus 5.5(66.4%)에 근소한 차이로 뒤쳐졌습니다. 또한 다양한 엔지니어링 도메인에서 코딩 에이전트의 다단계 실행, 도구 사용 및 엔드투엔드 문제 해결을 테스트하는 내부 벤치마크인 Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon에서 K3.1 Pro는 61.2%를 기록하여 K3의 55.95%보다 높았습니다. K3.1 Pro는 실제 코드베이스의 빠른 수정부터 전체 프로젝트 빌드까지 코딩 작업의 전체 범위를 다룹니다. 또한 게임 및 웹 경험에 더욱 세련된 시각적 스타일을 제공하고 적절한 도구로 이를 구축하는 방법을 알고 있습니다. K3.1 Pro는 Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot와 같은 게임 엔진에서 웹 검색 및 3D 생성을 결합하여 완벽한 경험을 만듭니다. 프런트 엔드 페이지, 대화형 Three.js 장면 및 3D 자산은 더 강력한 구성, 타이포그래피, 애니메이션 및 완성도를 보여줍니다. 아래 예시는 K3.1 Pro가 엔드투엔드로 생성한 것입니다. K3.1 Pro의 장기 코딩 기능은 대규모 강화 학습을 통해 더욱 강화되었습니다. 한 내부 테스트에서, 연골을 포함한 296개의 골격 구성 요소와 402개의 근육 구성 요소를 포함하는 인체에 대한 오픈 소스 해부학적 모델인 human-atlas 위에 통합 훈련 및 평가 파이프라인을 갖춘 인간 보행 역학 시뮬레이터를 구축했습니다. 167개의 미션과 420개의 독립적인 검토를 통해 실험 결과를 분석하고 문제를 진단하며 보행 컨트롤러를 반복적으로 개선하여 시뮬레이션된 인간이 몇 초 만에 쓰러지는 것에서 11.2초 동안 교대로 보폭을 사용하여 지속적으로 걷는 수준으로 만들었습니다. 보상 형성(reward shaping)이 팔 움직임을 개선하지 못했을 때 K3.1 Pro는 단순히 보상을 계속 조정하는 대신 시뮬레이터 역학에 대한 개방 루프 조사를 실행하고 어깨 근육 모멘트 암 계산에서 36개의 오류를 식별하고 수정한 다음 컨트롤러를 다시 훈련했습니다. K3.1 Pro는 3D 생성 및 공간 추론에 강합니다. CAD 코드 생성을 통해 다중 뷰 렌더링에서 3D 재구성을 테스트하는 BenchCAD에서 K3.1 Pro는 도구를 사용하여 92.7%를 기록하여 Claude Opus 5.5(96.2%) 및 GPT-6 Astra(95.9%)의 성능에 근접했습니다. 텍스트 브리핑, 스케치 또는 참조 이미지에서 모양, 비율 및 공간 관계를 추론하여 사용 가능한 3D 모델을 만들 수 있습니다. 또한 기존 자산 라이브러리 및 모델 컬렉션에 대한 이해도가 높습니다. K3.1 Pro는 기계 부품 및 건축 모델부터 구성 가능한 제품 및 맞춤형 가구에 이르기까지 파라메트릭 모델링에 특히 탁월합니다. MCP 커넥터 없이도 Blender 및 CAD 소프트웨어와 같은 도구에 대한 스크립트를 작성하고 실행하여 자산을 구축 및 정제하고 구성 요소를 편집하며 기하학, 재료 및 장면 레이아웃을 조정할 수 있습니다. 아래는 K3.1 Pro가 브랜드 필름, 게임 및 대화형 웹 경험을 위해 만든 3D 자산의 예입니다. 3D Make는 현재 kimi.ai 및 Kimi 앱에서 사용할 수 있습니다. 온라인에서 3D 모델을 미리 보고 편집하고, 3D 인쇄용으로 다운로드하거나, 비디오 또는 Live Photos로 내보내어 어디든 공유할 수 있습니다. 더 강력한 추론 및 에이전트 기능을 통해 K3.1 Pro는 완벽한 금융 워크플로우를 엔드투엔드로 제공할 수 있습니다. K3.1 Pro는 검색, 문서 간 검증 및 다단계 수치 추론을 통해 실제 금융 문서에 대한 복잡한 재정 데이터 분석을 테스트하는 OfficeQA Pro v2(64.4)에서 최첨단 결과를 달성합니다. K3.1 Pro는 또한 스크리닝부터 수익성 분석까지 완전한 투자 워크플로우를 지원하는 Frontier Finance에서 K3보다 개선되었습니다. K3.1 Pro는 또한 모든 내부 금융 벤치마크에서 크게 개선되었습니다. 재무 모델링은 실제 모델링 작업에서 수식 연결, 재무 논리 및 최종 통합 문서 품질을 평가합니다. K3.1 Pro는 K3보다 7.2점 향상되었습니다. 재무 연구는 모델이 증거 및 마감 제약 조건 하에서 감사 가능한 연구를 생성할 수 있는지 여부를 평가합니다. K3.1 Pro는 K3보다 11.6점 향상되었습니다. 비즈니스 운영은 시뮬레이션된 비즈니스 환경에서 장기적인 관리 및 의사 결정을 평가합니다. K3.1 Pro는 K3 성능의 약 4.2배를 달성합니다. 재무 분석 및 투자 연구는 높은 수준의 사실 정확성을 요구합니다. 이를 해결하기 위해 K3.1 Pro의 실제 작업 및 까다로운 프롬프트에 대한 사실 정확성을 목표로 개선했습니다. 사실 정확성을 스트레스 테스트하도록 설계된 내부 벤치마크인 Kimi Hallu Bench Hard 벤치에서 클레임 수준 환각률은 K3의 23.4%에서 8.3%로 떨어졌고, 하나 이상의 사실 오류를 포함하는 응답의 비율은 이전 버전의 42.4%에 불과했습니다. (평가는 사실 정확성에 대한 스트레스 테스트이며, 의도적으로 상황을 조사하도록 제작된 예시가 포함되어 있습니다.)

items.title: Show HN: Swurf – Swipe through the real web
items.body: Hello HN,Swurf allows you to swipe through the real web one page after another. It learns what you like and doesn’t show you the same page twice. The idea came naturally: there’s a seemingly infinite amount of high quality blog posts, random topic rabbit holes, and trending or cool sites that exist which the average person simply will never load on their browser. Swurf solves that by allowing you to rapidly traverse a constantly growing and learning feed of sites that it thinks you’d want to view. Quickly sift through endless pages and find things you like - effortlessly.One of the core drivers for making this project was the desire for real content. The project started as a simple tool for myself to find new and interesting things to learn and read about. Hours spent scrolling on my phone - while it still has its place - is increasingly losing its sense of reward. It’s genuinely hard to put into words exactly how swurfin’ feels but it’s almost refreshing in a sense. I encourage you to try it out and provide feedback. At this time there are no accounts and you can jump in and start swurfin’ immediately. There is a three dot menu button on the bottom right which allows you to submit links, save links, control adult content, and search similar topics. One of the things that’s great about Swurf is that its almost like a group browsing session (though entirely private) where everyone else who is spending time hunting down great reads or solid sites is helping massage the feed for you and you for them - all within your own set of interests.Enjoy and please ask any questions you have as theres plenty of room to grow.

items.title: The same AI request emits 8.5 times more CO2 in Texas than in Sweden
items.body:
About SEI, WattTime and Klimatkollen

Estimates based on the average emissions intensity of each regional electricity grid*

STOCKHOLM, 21 October 2026. Swedish AI provider Berget AI today releases an open-source method for calculating the carbon emissions of every individual AI request, developed with researchers from Stockholm Environment Institute (SEI) and the tech non-profits WattTime and Klimatkollen. Berget AI's customers can follow their own emissions in the company's console as they use the service. By making the method free for anyone to use, Berget AI wants more AI providers to report emissions per request, so that buyers can compare providers on real figures and choose lower-carbon options.

"Most companies today have no way of knowing what their use of AI emits. With this method our customers can follow their emissions request by request and compare providers on data instead of marketing. We know most European buyers would choose differently if they could see the numbers," says Andreas Lundmark, CEO of Berget AI.

A typical request to the open model Kimi K3 emits about 0.4 grams of CO₂ in Sweden, 1.6 grams in Ireland, 2.5 grams in Germany and 3.2 grams in Texas, on identical hardware — 8.5 times more in Texas than in Sweden. The result also depends on the model, the time of day and whether part of the prompt is cached, so the method calculates each request separately instead of applying an average. Berget AI reports location-based figures, using the average grid mix where the servers run, and includes the emissions from manufacturing the hardware.

Buyers rarely get emission figures from their AI providers, and the public figures that exist are mostly averages estimated from the outside. Open-weight models, which can run in any data centre, handle a growing share of AI traffic: 29% of tokens on Vercel's AI Gateway in June 2026, up from 11% in April. For those models, where a request runs is the buyer's choice, provided the emissions are visible.

"Most of the alarming figures about AI's footprint come from multiplying an average by a guess at the volume, and nobody can check them. The only fair comparison is to calculate each request and add them up. We have published our judgement calls so anyone can check and use them," says Christian Landgren, CTO and co-founder of Berget AI.

"The International Energy Agency projects data-centre electricity consumption to more than double to about 945 TWh by 2030, with AI as the principal driver. Any promise of efficiency gains is likely to be outweighed by higher demand, negating any emission reductions from renewables. Methodologies like this offer a transparent basis for informed decisions. Their strength is that they clearly demonstrate how the location of the grid and critical infrastructure matter when it comes to how sustainable AI can be," says Somya Joshi, Research Director at SEI.

The partners mapped and measured the environmental impact of Berget AI's infrastructure, including energy, water and hardware, as well as the carbon footprint of Klimatkollen's Garbo AI, which runs on it. They combined the data with current research on translating it into carbon emissions and broader environmental impact.

The method follows the Green Software Foundation's SCI for AI specification and is available under the MIT licence on GitHub. The calculator at co2.berget.ai applies it to any model and region. It builds on open-source estimators such as EcoLogits and the Sustainable AI Group's CLEER dashboard, which estimate emissions from outside the provider. As far as we know, Berget AI is the first inference provider to calculate emissions for every request on its own infrastructure and publish the method. The partners will keep developing it, for example to cover the water and energy footprint of chip manufacturing, which the current version does not include.

* Emissions estimates are based on the current average emissions intensity of each regional electricity grid, which has been the norm in greenhouse gas accounting. An emerging approach uses marginal emission rates, which estimate the impact of additional load on both the use of existing power plants and the new generators built to meet increased demand. Marginal estimates will be added to the calculator next month and may significantly change the measured greenhouse gas intensity of data centres in Sweden.

Correction, 21 October 2026: an earlier version of this release, distributed under embargo, stated 1.2 g (Ireland), 2.1 g (Germany) and 3.9 g (Texas) per request and a ten-fold difference between Texas and Sweden. A source review of the grid intensities published with this release corrected them to Ireland ~224, Germany ~337 and Texas ~333 g CO₂e/kWh; the corrected per-request figures appear above and the Texas–Sweden difference is 8.5×. Sweden's figure is unchanged.

Berget AI champions AI sovereignty to unlock innovation and growth in Europe. Founded in Sweden in 2024, Berget AI offers inference and AI infrastructure for private and public sector organisations. Since 2025 it has reported the CO₂ emissions of every API request.

About SEI, WattTime and Klimatkollen

Partners: Stockholm Environment Institute (knowledge partner), WattTime (scientific partner), Klimatkollen (partner).

Stockholm Environment Institute is an international non-profit research institute that tackles climate, environment and sustainable development challenges. To learn more, visit www.sei.org.

Klimatkollen.se is a Swedish citizen platform that presents climate data about municipalities and companies. The purpose is to contribute to more engaged citizens, a more fact-based climate debate, and measures that reduce emissions in line with the Paris Agreement. Klimatkollen is run by the non-profit association Klimatbyrån.

WattTime is an environmental tech nonprofit that empowers all people, companies, policymakers, and countries to slash emissions and choose cleaner energy. Founded by UC Berkeley researchers, we research, develop, and share data-driven tools and policies that help anyone who is interested to reduce more emissions, faster. www.watttime.org
