items.why_ko: 장기 학습 없이 즉석에서 상태 및 도함수를 추정하는 Diona는 실시간 데이터 분석 및 제어 시스템 등 빠른 응답이 필요한 애플리케이션에 유용할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Nonparametric autoregressive estimation of probability distributions with parallel gradient boosting
items.body: Nonparametric estimation of joint probability distributions is a core problem in statistics, which is notoriously challenging with high-dimensional data. Such challenges also arise with conditional distribution estimation and have led to flexible algorithms that aim to tackle the ''curse of dimensionality'' by exploiting predictive structures of lower dimension than the ambient space. In this paper, we study the use of such conditional distribution estimators to estimate joint distributions by factorizing the latter in an ''autoregressive'' way. We show that for loss functions satisfying a subadditivity property, bounds on the convergence rate of an autoregressive estimator can be derived from bounds on the convergence rate of the conditional distribution estimators. These bounds relate the difficulty of estimating the joint distribution to that of estimating the most challenging factor in the autoregressive factorization. When the conditional estimators adapt to sparsity in their conditioning sets, we characterize this difficulty through variable elimination in an undirected dependence graph. This allows bounding the rates of convergence by quantities related to the sparsity of the graph, and provides an additional motivation for the autoregressive approach. We then evaluate the practical performance of an autoregressive estimator based on parallel gradient boosting, a flexible nonparametric method for estimating conditional distributions. The estimator demonstrates competitive estimation performance on various simulated and real datasets, even without optimizing the factorization order. Together, these results support nonparametric autoregressive estimation as a practical approach to flexible joint distribution estimation.
items.title_ko: 병렬 그래디언트 부스팅을 이용한 확률 분포의 비모수 자기회귀 추정
items.summary_ko: 확률 분포의 비모수 추정은 통계학의 핵심 문제로, 고차원 데이터에서 특히 어렵습니다. 이 논문은 조건부 분포 추정량(conditional distribution estimator)을 사용하여 차원의 저주 문제를 해결하고, 병렬 그래디언트 부스팅을 통해 공동 분포를 추정하는 방법을 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: 고차원 데이터에서 확률 분포를 효율적으로 추정하는 방법은 예측 모델링, 이상 탐지 등 다양한 AI 응용 분야에서 핵심적인 기술입니다.

items.title: Beyond Causal Masks: Auditing and Localizing Hidden Future-Token Leakage in Adaptive Sequence Models
items.body: Hidden future-token leakage can create false architectural gains: an autoregressive model may appear substantially better under teacher-forced evaluation while its free-running generation deteriorates. We investigate this failure in an adaptive residual-routing decoder whose sequence-level routing summary exposes prefix positions to future tokens despite a correct causal attention mask. An anomalous 24-layer checkpoint reduces validation loss from the baseline's 3.5958 to 1.4259, yet it fails a prefix-invariance audit and has substantially higher reference-model perplexity during generation. Layer-wise diagnostics and implementation inspection trace the violation to a full-sequence summary broadcast through the dynamic routing-query path. Two independently trained 12-layer causal repairs eliminate detectable leakage and return validation loss and reference perplexity to the control scale, removing the large apparent advantage. As diagnostic tools, we use the established prefix-invariance contract, maximum prefix-output discrepancy (LeakScore), complementary behavioral metrics, and layer-wise profiles. Supporting experiments cover six synthetic implementation pairs spanning five module families, clean pretrained controls, controlled fault injection, and cache consistency across numerical precisions. These results illustrate how hidden future-token access can produce misleading claims of architectural progress and why lower teacher-forced loss should be interpreted together with whole-model causal checks and free-running evaluation.
items.title_ko: 인과 마스크를 넘어서: 적응형 시퀀스 모델의 숨겨진 미래 토큰 누출 감사 및 지역화
items.summary_ko: 숨겨진 미래 토큰 누출은 아키텍처적 이득을 잘못 만들어낼 수 있습니다. 이 논문은 적응형 잔여 라우팅 디코더에서 이러한 실패를 조사하며, 올바른 인과 어텐션 마스크에도 불구하고 시퀀스 수준 라우팅 요약이 미래 토큰에 접두사 위치를 노출하는 현상을 발견하고 이를 감사합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 숨겨진 데이터 누출 문제는 모델의 신뢰성을 저해하고 잘못된 성능 평가를 유도할 수 있으므로, 이를 탐지하고 해결하는 기술은 모델 개발의 필수적인 부분입니다.

items.title: Jev-DLC: Decision-Level Continual Learning from Typed Feedback
items.body: Individual preferences often become visible only after deployment, when a user accepts one decision or revokes it in favor of another. Jev-style typed interfaces make this feedback explicit by identifying the selected action and, under revocation, the decision it replaces. We study how these consequences persist across requests as Decision-Level Continual Learning from Typed Feedback (Jev-DLC). Jev-DLC treats each correction as both evidence about a recurring action identity and a directed relation between the preferred and rejected choices. It preserves these signals in complementary bounded channels above a frozen scorer and combines their scores to shape the next decision. The method retains no raw interaction history, adds no scorer call, and performs no runtime language-model backward pass. We also introduce TCPA-Bench, a chronological suite that credits a correction only through its effect on later decisions. On TCPA-Repeat, Jev-DLC reaches 44.83% user-macro accuracy overall, 2.43 points above Recent-4 history replay. After at least two earlier feedback events, it reaches 56.07%, a 7.54-point margin over the strongest reported comparison at this depth. These results show how explicit typed corrections can become compact causal state for continual personalization.
items.title_ko: Jev-DLC: 유형 피드백을 통한 의사결정 수준 지속 학습
items.summary_ko: 개별 선호도는 배포 후에야 드러나는 경우가 많습니다. Jev 스타일의 인터페이스는 선택된 행동을 식별하고, 취소 시 대체된 결정을 명시하여 이러한 피드백을 명확하게 합니다. 이 논문은 이러한 결과를 '유형 피드백을 통한 의사결정 수준 지속 학습(Jev-DLC)'으로 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: 사용자 피드백을 활용하여 AI 시스템이 지속적으로 학습하고 개선되는 방법은 개인화된 서비스와 동적인 환경에 적응하는 AI 에이전트 개발에 중요합니다.

items.title: The Geometry of Metaphor: Probing and Steering Metaphor Representations in Large Language Models
items.body: Metaphor is a crucial aspect of human cognition. As such, we would like to understand how it is represented in large language models (LLMs) and how it might be controlled. We use mechanistic interpretability techniques to identify causal subspaces in a range of LLMs covering different architectures and sizes. We show that we are able to steer output on classification tasks across different parts of speech. We are also able to steer output on generation tasks, indicating that these techniques can be used to control the metaphoricity of LLM output.
items.title_ko: 은유의 기하학: 대규모 언어 모델에서 은유 표현 조사 및 조종
items.summary_ko: 은유는 인간 인지의 중요한 측면이며, LLM에서 어떻게 표현되고 제어될 수 있는지 이해하는 것이 중요합니다. 이 논문은 기계적 해석 가능성(mechanistic interpretability) 기술을 사용하여 다양한 LLM에서 인과적 부분 공간을 식별하고, 품사별 분류 및 생성 작업의 출력을 조종할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: LLM이 은유와 같은 복잡한 언어 현상을 어떻게 처리하는지 이해하고 이를 제어하는 것은 모델의 언어 이해 및 생성 능력을 심화하고 창의적인 AI 애플리케이션 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: From Prompt Rules to Golden Data Model: Production-Scale Generation of Personalized, Compliant Pharmaceutical Claims
items.body: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate domain-specific commercial & medical content (e.g., claims, statements, and promotional phrases) in regulated industries such as pharmaceuticals. However, ensuring its regulatory compliance, factual accuracy, and audience-specific personalization remains a major challenge. We report a production case study asking whether moving compliance and personalization signal from prompt-level rules into retrieval time structured context improves pharmaceutical claims generation, using Composer, a deployed internal tool built on a Golden Data Model (GDM) of 1,867 pharmaceutical claims spanning four products. The GDM integrates claim metadata, references, audience labels, material type, usage history, Match Text Variant (MTV) links, and a six dimension quality score (6C). Across six product-audience segments, the context pipeline improves intended indication (+29%), intended content type (+62%) and intended target audience (+67%), 6C quality score (+86%), and claim reuse (+34%). Production log analysis over the deployment period shows a 29.5% reduction in weekly API cost. We report this as descriptive deployment evidence. This work is a systems and data architecture contribution: it shows that in a regulated, high-stakes domain, restructuring claim data for retrieval-time filtering is a more scalable lever than expanding prompt-level rules, and documents the engineering path data cleaning, graph linking, and quality scoring.
items.title_ko: 프롬프트 규칙에서 골든 데이터 모델로: 맞춤형, 규제 준수 제약 생성의 대규모 생산
items.summary_ko: LLM은 규제 산업에서 도메인별 상업 및 의료 콘텐츠를 생성하는 데 사용되지만, 규제 준수, 사실 정확성, 개인화 보장이 주요 과제입니다. 이 논문은 프롬프트 수준 규칙에서 검색 시간 구조화된 컨텍스트로 준수 및 개인화 신호를 이동하는 것이 성능을 향상시키는지 여부를 조사합니다.
items.why_ko: 규제 산업에서 LLM을 활용할 때, 규제 준수와 개인화를 효율적으로 달성하는 방법은 실제 비즈니스 적용에 필수적인 실무 노하우입니다.

items.title: Towards User Simulators That Stay On Task And Still Sound Natural
items.body: Users increasingly rely on AI systems for extended, multi-turn tasks, yet evidence indicates that LLM-based system performance degrades over prolonged interaction. To evaluate and improve AI assistants in such settings, we need user simulators that faithfully follow complex user intents while exhibiting realistic conversational behavior. Existing approaches manifest a trade-off: prompted assistants can follow complex user intents but lack behavioral fidelity, while specialized user simulators better approximate conversational behavior but struggle to remain faithful to complex intents. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) recipe that jointly rewards task intent adherence and behavioral naturalness. A crucial contribution of the method is operationalizing naturalness with a lightweight discriminator trained in an alternating, adversarial loop with the user simulator. We release the resulting model, UserLM-2.0, which produces valid simulated conversations (i.e., meeting both task-faithfulness and naturalness criteria) 46.2% of the time, over three times the rate of the strongest prior user simulator (14.1%).
items.title_ko: 작업을 유지하고 자연스러운 소리를 내는 사용자 시뮬레이터 방향
items.summary_ko: 사용자들은 점점 더 장기간의 다중 턴 작업에서 AI 시스템에 의존하지만, LLM 기반 시스템의 성능은 상호작용이 길어질수록 저하됩니다. 이 논문은 복잡한 사용자 의도를 충실히 따르면서도 현실적인 대화 행동을 보이는 사용자 시뮬레이터의 필요성을 제기합니다.
items.why_ko: 복잡한 다중 턴 대화에서 AI 어시스턴트의 성능 저하 문제를 해결하기 위한 현실적인 사용자 시뮬레이터 개발은 대화형 AI 시스템의 발전에 중요합니다.

items.title: DuoCook: An Overcooked-Inspired Benchmark for Visual Planning and Coordination
items.body: Coordinating two players in a cooking task requires a vision-language agent to track changing scene states, sequence recipe steps, and allocate shared resources under a time budget. We introduce an Overcooked-inspired benchmark for evaluating these capabilities in Unreal Engine environments constructed using coding agents. A single vision-language model controls both players from top-down visual observations, selecting high-level actions while the engine executes navigation. The benchmark contains 20 maps in five categories. These categories support evaluation of centralized coordination under equipment contention, changing terrain, and handoff dependencies. A prop legend and pot ingredient-count indicators provide explicit visual cues, while grid-based destinations support spatial grounding. The evaluation compares four VLMs on all 20 maps, measuring task score, order completion, delivery precision, action acceptance rate, and model API expenditure. A memory ablation on the same 20 maps examines the effect of a shared, self-authored notebook while retaining six-response action history in both conditions. The strongest evaluated model, \texttt{gpt-6-astra}, achieves 26.2\% mean order completion. Notebook memory has mixed score effects across models, with positive mean differences for Claude and Qwen and negative differences for GPT and Gemini.
items.title_ko: DuoCook: 시각적 계획 및 조정을 위한 Overcooked 기반 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 요리 작업을 수행하는 두 플레이어를 조정하기 위해 시각-언어 에이전트에게 필요한 능력(장면 상태 추적, 레시피 단계 시퀀싱, 자원 할당)을 평가하기 위한 Overcooked 기반 벤치마크인 DuoCook을 소개합니다. Unreal Engine 환경에서 시각-언어 모델 하나가 두 플레이어를 제어합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇 협동 및 시각적 계획 분야에서 LLM 에이전트의 멀티모달 능력과 협업 능력을 평가하는 새로운 벤치마크는 더욱 복잡한 로봇 시스템 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Piano2Pop: Expanding Piano Demos into Pop Productions Without Aligned Supervision
items.body: We introduce Piano2Pop, a music-expansion task that transforms piano MIDI into instrumental pop productions. Enabled by recent advances in music generation and polyphonic music transcription, our pseudo-supervised approach conditions a pretrained flow-matching model on piano rolls without aligned piano-pop supervision. We train on synthetic piano-instrumental pairs derived from pop recordings, comparing pair-free transcription, including function-selective (FST) and register-density (RDA) augmentations, with a pair-supervised piano-cover generator as pseudo-demo sources. On 476 testing real-world piano-cover/pop pairs, the pair-supervised approach achieves the best Frechet Audio Distance, Accompaniment Prompt Adherence, and spectral shape on real-piano inputs, while FST mitigates piano-heavy outputs in pair-free training and remains a promising alternative. All fine-tuned systems significantly outperform the zero-shot baselines, which suggests a role for task-specific modeling.
items.title_ko: Piano2Pop: 정렬된 감독 없이 피아노 데모를 팝 프로덕션으로 확장
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 피아노 MIDI를 악기 팝 프로덕션으로 변환하는 음악 확장 작업인 Piano2Pop을 소개합니다. 음악 생성 및 다성 음악 전사의 최근 발전을 활용하여, 정렬된 피아노-팝 감독 없이 사전 훈련된 플로우 매칭 모델을 피아노 롤에 조건화하는 의사 감독 접근 방식을 사용합니다.
items.why_ko: 정렬된 데이터 없이 음악 장르 간 변환을 가능하게 하는 기술은 AI 음악 창작의 새로운 가능성을 열고, 아티스트들에게 새로운 도구를 제공할 수 있습니다.

items.title: FairFRESH: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Fair and Explainable Household Food Recommendation
items.body: Recommender systems typically serve one user at a time. However, in households, members share a finite pantry and follow different dietary rules, making independent recommendations prone to resource conflicts and dietary violations. We formulate household food recommendation as constrained fair division and present FairFRESH, a neuro-symbolic framework that learns per-member utilities, allocates foods under explicit welfare objectives, enforces dietary rules through a deterministic filter, and explains recommendations using Shapley and Banzhaf attributions. Theoretically, we show that no finite penalty guarantees compliance near a dietary-rule threshold, establish approximation guarantees for greedy allocation under utilitarian and smoothed Nash objectives in the stock-free model before filtering, and characterize the scale invariance of Nash welfare. We also use the minimax theorem to analyze rotating shared meals. On NHANES-derived data, the learned utility model achieves Recall@20 of 0.293, outperforming five learned recommenders (at most 0.244) but not a previous-day repetition heuristic (0.321). On held-out four-person households, Nash allocation reduces Gini disparity by 42% relative to conflict resolution while improving Recall@20 from 0.180 to 0.197. It comes within 2% of an upper bound on the smoothed Nash optimum, and rescaling one member's utilities changes at most 1.5% of assignments. All recommendations satisfy the encoded dietary rules, while attribution scores correlate with utility loss upon component removal (r = 0.76). In simulation, shared meals reduce pantry use by about one-third, and weekly rotation increases the worst-off member's utility by 38% over the best fixed meal.
items.title_ko: FairFRESH: 공정하고 설명 가능한 가구 식품 추천을 위한 신경-기호 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 추천 시스템이 일반적으로 한 번에 한 사용자에게 서비스하지만, 가구에서는 공유된 식료품 저장실과 다른 식단 규칙으로 인해 갈등이 발생할 수 있다고 지적합니다. 가구 식품 추천을 제약된 공정 분배 문제로 공식화하고, 회원별 효용을 학습하고 식단을 강제하는 신경-기호 프레임워크 FairFRESH를 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 다중 사용자 환경에서 공정성, 식단 제약, 설명 가능성을 모두 고려하는 추천 시스템은 실제 생활에 AI를 적용할 때 중요한 기술적 도전 과제를 해결합니다.

items.title: Structure-preserving reduced-order models of thin panels in supersonic and hypersonic flow
items.body: We build structure-preserving reduced-order models for both challenge problems of the AePW-4 High-Speed Working Group. They are a clamped thin panel at Mach 1.92 (RC-19) and a cantilever plate at Mach 5.85 (HyMAX). The published data for each case hold no time-resolved response and no repeated runs. The physics must therefore be carried by the form of the model. One construction gives two models per problem. A Ritz-Galerkin reference model describes the plate. A learned model keeps the reference model's exact potential, fits the remaining generalized forces, and trains only a dissipation that cannot add energy. Its energy balance holds for any weights by construction. On the trained model the worst relative residual is 2.2e-15. On RC-19, shock relations predict a pressure ratio of 1.521 across the panel. Pressure-sensitive paint measured the same value. Thirty runs of the learned model place the mean dominant frequency within 1.0% of the measured 236 Hz. At one periodic and one chaotic condition, the learned model reproduces the response regime of a published reduced-order model in all sixteen runs. It does so without that model's 113 Hz spectral peak, which the measurements do not show. Measured displacements can also correct the chaotic response through one more force that respects the energy balance. We tested this on synthetic data at the experiment's 5 kHz sampling rate. The state error is 1.25% of the panel thickness without noise and 3.5% with 10 micrometers of noise. On HyMAX the learned model follows the reference model's trailing-edge displacement for 65 ms with a relative error of 3.7%. These results show that a model whose structure carries the physics can match measured flutter behavior when the available data cannot train it.
items.title_ko: 초음속 및 극초음속 흐름에서 얇은 패널의 구조 보존 축소 차수 모델
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 AePW-4 고속 워킹 그룹의 두 가지 도전 과제(Mach 1.92의 고정된 얇은 패널, Mach 5.85의 캔틸레버 플레이트)를 위한 구조 보존 축소 차수 모델을 구축합니다. 발표된 데이터에는 시간 해결 응답이나 반복 실행이 없어, 물리적 형태가 모델에 의해 전달되어야 합니다.
items.why_ko: 고속 유체 역학 시뮬레이션에서 효율적이고 정확한 모델링은 항공우주 분야의 설계 및 분석에 중요한 기여를 할 수 있습니다.

items.title: SABLE: Scalable Affine Bayesian Latent-space Exploration
items.body: Complex objects such as engineering designs and proteins are often difficult to optimise because their design spaces exhibit high-dimensional structure and objective evaluations are expensive. Generative models provide continuous latent representations, but their latent spaces can have thousands to tens of thousands of dimensions, creating a regime where the latent dimension $D$ greatly exceeds the evaluation budget. We introduce SABLE, a Bayesian optimisation method for high-dimensional latent spaces with an isotropic distribution and limited budget. SABLE uses a Bayesian affine surrogate for prediction and acquisition, treating higher-order structure as surrogate discrepancy. After $N$ observations, the slope update has dimension at most $N-1$, yielding a decomposition of each query into an in-span component optimised by expected improvement (EI) in at most $N$ dimensions and an off-span component governed by a scalar norm. We show that the off-span norm implicitly selected by affine EI can lead to underexploration, and SABLE instead prescribes it using a finite-horizon schedule, without restricting search to a learned subspace. A recompression scheme reduces information to $\mathcal O(M)$ pseudo-observations, bounding refitting cost by $\mathcal O(M^2D+M^3)$ while keeping parameter inference, prediction, and acquisition decisions to tens of milliseconds. Across synthetic benchmarks and latent-space optimisation tasks, SABLE achieves high sample efficiency and reduces decision time by several orders of magnitude at large budgets.
items.title_ko: SABLE: 확장 가능한 아핀 베이지안 잠재 공간 탐색
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 공학 설계 및 단백질과 같은 복잡한 객체는 설계 공간이 고차원적이고 목적 함수 평가가 비싸기 때문에 최적화하기 어렵다고 지적합니다. SABLE은 이러한 고차원 잠재 공간에서 베이지안 최적화 방법으로, 잠재 차원이 평가 예산을 크게 초과하는 상황을 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 고차원 공간에서 효율적인 최적화 기술은 복잡한 설계 문제나 신약 개발 등 AI 기반 탐색이 필요한 분야에서 중요한 도구입니다.

items.title: Training Small Language Models for Transferable Tool Selection
items.body: As LLM agents operate over corpora of more than ten thousand tools, selecting the right tool for a complex multi-step user instruction becomes a central bottleneck. Tool descriptions cannot all fit in context, and relevance-based retrievers only rank tools without knowing which are actually needed. Recent work instead leverages proprietary commercial LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT to drive a retriever, decomposing the instruction and selecting over retrieved candidates. We show that a small, open model can be trained via reinforcement learning to perform the same functionality. On ToolBench, a Qwen3-8B model post-trained with our recipe outperforms Llama-4-Maverick (402B). In addition, the trained model transfers directly to different retrievers and generalizes to new tool corpora in different domains.
items.title_ko: 전이 가능한 도구 선택을 위한 소형 언어 모델 훈련
items.summary_ko: LLM 에이전트가 만 개 이상의 도구를 다룰 때, 복잡한 다단계 사용자 지시에 맞는 올바른 도구를 선택하는 것이 핵심 병목 현상이 됩니다. 이 논문은 소규모 오픈 모델을 훈련하여 독점 상업 LLM과 경쟁력 있는 도구 선택 성능을 달성할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 소규모 LLM으로도 효율적인 도구 선택이 가능하다는 것은 LLM 에이전트의 활용 범위를 넓히고, 비용 효율적인 AI 애플리케이션 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Evaluating the Applicability of LLM Inference Optimizations on Apple Silicon
items.body: Apple Silicon is among the most widely used platforms for local LLM inference, yet nearly all inference optimizations are designed and validated on server-class NVIDIA GPUs under batched serving workloads. Which optimizations retain their benefits when moved to Apple Silicon, and what determines their applicability? We evaluate four optimization families: KV-cache pruning, speculative decoding, ported GPU kernels, and post-training quantization. Experiments span four Apple machines under a common single-request decode workload, with matched RTX 4090 comparisons where possible. KV-cache pruning can reach up to 1.75 times end-to-end throughput on Apple but can reduce throughput on desktop NVIDIA GPUs. Under the common benchmark, all evaluated speculative decoding methods reduce throughput on Apple, despite reported 2-6 times gains on server GPUs. CUDA kernel designs transfer only partially: public Metal lacks asynchronous copy, and batch-one decode makes several serving-oriented mechanisms inapplicable, although transferable components yield up to 1.20 times decode throughput. Quantization gains vary by machine. Across four families, a reported speedup is not a portable property of a technique alone but a joint function of technique, runtime, hardware contract, and workload regime.
items.body_ko: Apple Silicon은 로컬 LLM 추론에 가장 널리 사용되는 플랫폼 중 하나이지만, 거의 모든 추론 최적화는 배치 서빙 워크로드 하의 서버급 NVIDIA GPU에서 설계되고 검증됩니다. Apple Silicon으로 옮겨졌을 때 어떤 최적화가 이점을 유지하며, 무엇이 적용 가능성을 결정할까요? 우리는 KV-캐시 가지치기(KV-cache pruning), 추측성 디코딩(speculative decoding), 포팅된 GPU 커널(ported GPU kernels), 그리고 훈련 후 양자화(post-training quantization)의 네 가지 최적화 계열을 평가합니다. 실험은 공통적인 단일 요청 디코딩 워크로드 하의 네 대의 Apple 머신에서 진행되었으며, 가능한 경우 RTX 4090과의 비교도 포함했습니다. KV-캐시 가지치기는 Apple에서 종단 간 처리량을 최대 1.75배까지 높일 수 있지만, 데스크톱 NVIDIA GPU에서는 처리량을 감소시킬 수 있습니다. 일반적인 벤치마크에서 평가된 모든 추측성 디코딩 방법은 서버 GPU에서 2-6배의 이득이 보고되었음에도 불구하고 Apple에서는 처리량을 감소시킵니다. CUDA 커널 설계는 부분적으로만 이전됩니다. 공개 Metal은 비동기 복사를 지원하지 않으며, 배치-1 디코딩은 여러 서빙 지향 메커니즘을 적용할 수 없게 만듭니다. 하지만 이전 가능한 구성 요소는 최대 1.20배의 디코딩 처리량을 제공합니다. 양자화 이득은 머신마다 다릅니다. 네 가지 계열에 걸쳐, 보고된 속도 향상은 기술 단독의 휴대 가능한 속성이 아니라 기술, 런타임, 하드웨어 계약, 워크로드 체제의 공동 함수입니다.
items.title_ko: Apple Silicon에서 LLM 추론 최적화 적용 가능성 평가
items.summary_ko: Apple Silicon은 로컬 LLM 추론에 가장 널리 사용되는 플랫폼 중 하나지만, 거의 모든 추론 최적화는 서버급 NVIDIA GPU의 배치 서비스 워크로드를 위해 설계되고 검증됩니다. 이 연구는 KV-캐시 가지치기, 추측성 디코딩, 포팅된 GPU 커널, 사후 훈련 양자화 등 네 가지 최적화 기법이 Apple Silicon에서 어떤 이점을 유지하는지 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: Apple Silicon에서 LLM 추론을 최적화하는 실증적 연구는 온디바이스 AI 개발자들에게 성능 향상을 위한 구체적인 지침과 기법을 제공하여 개발 역량에 직접적인 도움이 됩니다.

items.title: MoG-VLM: Efficient Video Anomaly Detection through Motion-Guided Vision-Language Models
items.body: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection, but dense frame-level inference makes them impractical for real-time deployment. Existing acceleration commonly relies on uniform sampling, which ignores content dynamics and can either waste computation on static segments or miss localized anomalies. We propose MoG-VLM a motion-adaptive anomaly detection framework that leverages motion purely as a lightweight control signal to decide when VLM inference is necessary. To this end, we introduce Temporal Gradient Magnitude (TGM) which performs content-aware sampling to concentrate computation on informative regions while avoiding redundant processing. We further introduce a hierarchical dual-stream design in which dense multi-frame VLM reasoning is activated only around frames with elevated anomaly likelihood, via anchor-triggered context-window expansion with early termination. A fusion module then reconciles these instantaneous semantic cues with temporal action dynamics. Across four benchmarks, our method achieves 91.91%, 84.30%, 87.88%, and 78.96% AUC-ROC on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, MSAD, and ShanghaiTech, respectively, establishing new state of the art on three benchmarks under the zero-shot, training-free setting. On XD-Violence, we improve over the previous best result by +0.57% while delivering a 1.31x inference speedup. These results demonstrate that content-aware allocation of VLM capacity, processing fewer frames more intelligently rather than all frames uniformly, is a more effective axis of progress than uniformly densifying VLM inference across frames. Code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/kdawoud91/MoG-VLM.
items.title_ko: MoG-VLM: 모션 가이드 VLM을 통한 효율적인 비디오 이상 탐지
items.summary_ko: VLM은 비디오 이상 탐지에 큰 잠재력을 보이지만, 프레임 단위의 밀집 추론은 실시간 배포를 어렵게 합니다. 이 논문은 모션을 경량 제어 신호로 활용하여 VLM 추론이 언제 필요한지 결정하는 모션 적응형 이상 탐지 프레임워크인 MoG-VLM을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: VLM의 비디오 이상 탐지 효율성을 높이는 것은 실시간 감시 시스템, 자율 주행 등 시간 민감성이 중요한 애플리케이션에서 AI의 실용성을 향상시킵니다.

items.title: Measuring the Verifier's Floor: How Much Apparent Rare-Word Text-to-Speech Error Is ASR Error?
items.body: Text-to-speech (TTS) is usually evaluated by transcribing its output with an automatic speech recognition (ASR) system, so the word error rate also counts recognizer errors. We measure these errors on human recordings of the test sentences. On LibriSpeech and FLEURS, the evaluation recognizer misses 33-67% of very rare words even in human speech, and all three recognizers miss 22-42%. Checking every word with two more recognizer families lowers the apparent TTS error on words that at least one recognizer hears two- to three-fold (very rare LibriSpeech words: from 10-13% to 3-5%), yet very rare words remain the hardest. Ignoring words the recognizer misses in human speech is biased: the other recognizers find TTS errors far more often on these words (4-6% vs. 0.2-0.3%) and overturn about half of the errors this mask keeps. As half of the remaining adjudicated errors may be spelling variants, a listening test is needed.
items.title_ko: Verifier's Floor 측정: 희귀 단어 Text-to-Speech 오류 중 ASR 오류는 얼마나 되는가?
items.summary_ko: Text-to-speech (TTS)는 일반적으로 ASR(자동 음성 인식) 시스템으로 출력을 전사하여 평가되므로, 단어 오류율에는 인식기 오류도 포함됩니다. 이 논문은 테스트 문장의 사람 녹음에서 이러한 ASR 오류를 측정하여, 매우 희귀한 단어의 경우 인간 음성에서도 인식기가 33-67%를 놓친다는 것을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: TTS 시스템 평가의 정확성을 높이기 위해 ASR 시스템의 오류를 보정하는 방법을 이해하는 것은 음성 기술 개발자에게 중요한 고려사항입니다.

items.title: From Structured Records to Patient Narratives: Preserving Clinical Alignment in LLM-Generated Health Summaries
items.body: As wearable and digital health systems increasingly generate longitudinal physiological records, communicating these observations in patient-accessible language remains a significant challenge. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising mechanism for translating structured clinical information into readable narratives, but this process may introduce semantic drift, where clinically precise meaning is distorted during simplification. We investigate evidence-grounded health summarization for menstrual health monitoring using a constrained generation framework that combines structured evidence conditioning with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using a prompt-based constrained generation framework. We evaluate semantic alignment using Natural Language Inference (NLI), atomic factuality metrics, and readability measures. Across three LLMs and 4,500 generated summaries, explicit grounding constraints consistently improve clinical alignment, particularly by improving uncertainty preservation and, once faithfulness is evaluated against retrieved evidence, generally preserving or improving faithfulness, while effects on omission remain model-dependent. We also find that improved clinical alignment comes at the cost of increased reading difficulty and medical terminology. These findings highlight the need to jointly evaluate faithfulness, uncertainty preservation, and readability when developing patient-facing medical LLM systems.
items.title_ko: 구조화된 기록에서 환자 내러티브로: LLM 생성 건강 요약에서 임상적 일관성 유지
items.summary_ko: 웨어러블 및 디지털 건강 시스템이 생리적 기록을 생성하면서, 이를 환자가 이해하기 쉬운 언어로 전달하는 것이 과제입니다. LLM은 구조화된 임상 정보를 읽기 쉬운 내러티브로 번역하는 유망한 메커니즘을 제공하지만, 이 과정에서 임상적 의미가 왜곡되는 '의미론적 드리프트'가 발생할 수 있습니다. 이 논문은 증거 기반 건강 요약을 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM을 활용한 의료 정보 요약 시 임상적 정확성과 환자 이해도를 동시에 높이는 방법은 AI 기반 헬스케어 서비스의 신뢰성과 유용성을 결정하는 핵심 요소입니다.

items.title: RheOPT: Few-Shot Non-Newtonian Flow Prediction via Newtonian Pretraining of RheOFormer
items.body: Despite advances in numerical methods, non-Newtonian flow simulations remain computationally expensive because velocity and stress must be advanced together through rate- and history-dependent constitutive dynamics. Neural-operator surrogates reduce inference cost after training, but their training data require the same expensive simulations they aim to replace, making data-efficient learning essential when only a few non-Newtonian simulations can be afforded. Here, we introduce the Rheological Operator Pretrained Transformer (RheOPT), which pretrains a transformer-based neural operator on inexpensive Newtonian simulations and fine-tunes it on a small number of non-Newtonian samples. Rather than transferring the Newtonian constitutive response itself, RheOPT reuses geometry-conditioned transport structure that remains useful after the stress model changes. We evaluate RheOPT in two geometry-matched settings: a $4{:}1$ contraction channel for Giesekus, Oldroyd-B, and Bingham fluids, and the oscillatory wake behind a triangular obstacle for Oldroyd-B flow. In the contraction, Newtonian pretraining substantially improves few-shot prediction, and a model fine-tuned on four target samples can match or exceed a from-scratch model trained on four times as many. This benefit is reliable under reversible instance normalization (RevIN) but dataset dependent under Global normalization, a difference we trace to the dynamic range of each fluid's velocity and stress fields. In the wake, where relative $L_2$ error alone cannot verify that vortex shedding is recovered, phase-insensitive diagnostics show that pretraining recovers the shedding frequency and wake fluctuation amplitude that are suppressed by the from-scratch model in the few-shot regime. Overall, RheOPT establishes Newtonian simulation as a physically grounded pretraining source for data-efficient non-Newtonian operator learning.
items.title_ko: RheOPT: Newtonian 사전 훈련을 통한 비뉴턴 유동 예측의 Few-Shot 학습
items.summary_ko: 수치적 방법의 발전에도 불구하고 비뉴턴 유동 시뮬레이션은 여전히 계산 비용이 높습니다. 이 논문은 RheOFormer의 Newtonian 사전 훈련을 통해 추론 비용을 줄이고 데이터 효율적인 학습을 가능하게 하는 Few-Shot 비뉴턴 유동 예측 방법 RheOPT를 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: 계산 비용이 높은 과학 시뮬레이션에서 효율적인 데이터 학습 방법은 공학 설계 및 재료 과학 연구를 가속화하는 데 중요한 기여를 합니다.

items.title: Adaptive Skill Granularity for Coding Agents: Runtime Routing and Macro-to-Micro Recovery
items.body: Reusable skills allow large language model agents to package task-specific procedures, tool affordances, and execution guidance into modular units. Prior work has largely studied how agents retrieve, compose, or synthesize skills before execution. In coding agents, however, execution poses an additional runtime control problem: the same task may be solved through primitive tool calls, macro skills, or hybrid execution that starts with a macro and falls back to micro-level recovery. We introduce Adaptive Skill Granularity, a framework that treats skill granularity as an action-abstraction policy conditioned on task structure, execution state, and macro-skill failures. The system combines a feature-based granularity controller and a finite-state recovery executor. We evaluate the framework with a deterministic coding-agent protocol using verifier-defined success, total cost, and process metrics such as macro adoption, failure recovery, route match, and transition correctness. Results show that fixed macro execution is efficient when applicable but brittle under mismatch, while runtime routing and explicit macro-to-micro recovery improve robustness and recover controlled macro failures that fixed-granularity execution leaves unresolved. Our findings suggest that skill libraries for coding agents should be treated not only as retrievable resources, but also as controllable, verifiable, and recoverable execution abstractions.
items.title_ko: 코딩 에이전트를 위한 적응형 스킬 세분화: 런타임 라우팅 및 매크로-마이크로 복구
items.summary_ko: 재사용 가능한 스킬은 LLM 에이전트가 작업별 절차, 도구 사용성, 실행 지침을 모듈식 단위로 묶을 수 있게 합니다. 이 논문은 코딩 에이전트에서 런타임 제어 문제를 다루며, 기본 도구 호출, 매크로 스킬 또는 매크로로 시작하여 마이크로 수준 복구로 전환하는 하이브리드 실행을 통해 동일한 작업을 해결할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 코딩 에이전트가 복잡한 작업을 유연하게 처리할 수 있도록 하는 적응형 스킬 관리 및 실행 전략은 AI 개발 생산성을 높이는 데 핵심적인 기술입니다.

items.title: How Different, or Different How? Stance Granularity in Viewpoint Selection for Dialog Systems that Engage Users with Alternative Views
items.body: Systems that aim to help a user engage with viewpoints other than their own have to decide how different those viewpoints should be. Viewpoints are mainly represented on a scalar scale, too coarse to distinguish viewpoints that disagree with the user about different things. We introduce a selection policy in which a bandit sets how far viewpoints may sit from the user, and the policy selects the most novel viewpoint within that bound. We vary only its stance encoder, comparing a scalar score with Perspectivized Stance Vectors, which break a position into separate stances on concepts. We integrate it inside a dialog system and run a between-subjects study (N=63). Concept-level stance produces more varied exposure sequences and broader coverage of the topic's positions, but does not change how deeply users justify viewpoints or how accurately they reconstruct them. Finally, we analyze user--viewpoint relations at the concept level, showing that users reconstruct a viewpoint least accurately on concepts that one side took no position on, rather than on concepts where the two disagreed. Our findings open up opportunities for dialog systems that support engagement with alternative viewpoints by acting on which concepts a user and a viewpoint disagree on, rather than on distance alone.
items.title_ko: 대화 시스템의 관점 선택에서 입장 세분화: 얼마나 다른가, 또는 어떻게 다른가?
items.summary_ko: 사용자가 자신과 다른 관점과 상호작용하도록 돕는 시스템은 그 관점이 얼마나 달라야 하는지 결정해야 합니다. 이 논문은 기존의 스칼라 척도가 너무 거칠어 다른 것에 대해 동의하지 않는 관점을 구별하기 어렵다고 지적하며, 새로운 선택 정책을 도입합니다.
items.why_ko: 대화형 AI 시스템이 다양한 관점을 제시하여 사용자에게 새로운 시각을 제공하는 것은 정보 탐색 및 의사결정 지원 분야에서 중요합니다.

items.title: Multi-Token Prediction and Alternative Tokenization Improve Learning Latent Multi-Hop Graph Search at Scale
items.body: Given an unseen graph, a start node, $s$, and an end node, $t$, can a language model generate the shortest path from $s$ to $t$? Prior work has found that models fail to learn this task as the graphs scale. We show that this failure has two causes: the supervision signal and the tokenization. First, we theoretically establish and empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of multi-token prediction (MTP), and show that the benefits of MTP are topologically agnostic. Second, we introduce alternative tokenizations and show that the two causes are orthogonal. Using these methods, we break through the scaling wall observed by prior work, consistently and stably learning to solve the task at scales far beyond previous limits.
items.title_ko: 멀티 토큰 예측 및 대체 토큰화가 대규모 잠재 다중 홉 그래프 검색 학습을 개선
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 언어 모델이 그래프 크기가 커질수록 주어진 그래프에서 시작 노드부터 끝 노드까지 최단 경로를 생성하는 데 실패하는 문제를 다룹니다. 이 실패의 두 가지 원인으로 감독 신호와 토큰화를 지적하며, 멀티 토큰 예측(MTP)의 효과를 이론적으로 입증하고 경험적으로 시연합니다.
items.why_ko: 대규모 그래프에서 효율적으로 경로를 검색하는 LLM의 능력은 복잡한 데이터 구조를 분석하고 추론하는 AI 시스템의 성능을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: DIAL: Steerable Language Models with Distilled Instruction-Adherence Levels
items.body: When a user says "Keep it short", how short should the LLM's response be? More generally, users and applications require different levels of instruction adherence, but prompting does not reliably provide fine-grained control over them. We therefore study "steerable language models" that provide fine-grained numerical control over the degree to which models follow general instructions specified in text. However, existing approaches do not jointly offer fine-grained control, efficiency, and scalability across diverse instructions. To address this gap, we introduce DIAL (Distilled Instruction-Adherence Levels) to achieve all three properties. For fine-grained control, we perform classifier-free guidance (CFG) with a frozen LLM to provide training signals for on-policy distillation of instruction adherence at different levels. For efficiency, we design a lightweight steering adapter that uses a classifier over the LLM's hidden states to compute a closed-form steering edit. The classifier adaptively sets the steering magnitude at each token based on the target adherence level, while accounting for the geometry of the LLM's hidden states to preserve response coherence. For scalability, the classifier is text-conditioned, allowing a shared adapter to support new instructions without per-instruction fitting, and training requires only instruction and request text. Evaluation across multiple LLM families shows that DIAL achieves a competitive balance between concept expression and response fluency, with concept scores increasing monotonically across adherence levels. We introduce SteerIF, an instruction-only dataset of 98, 625 concept, persona, verifiable, and descriptive instructions. When trained on SteerIF, DIAL provides fine-grained control over personas and, when combined with prompting, improves verifiable instruction following.
items.title_ko: DIAL: 증류된 지시 준수 수준을 통한 조종 가능한 언어 모델
items.summary_ko: 사용자와 애플리케이션은 다양한 수준의 지시 준수를 요구하지만, 프롬프팅만으로는 세밀한 제어가 어렵습니다. 이 논문은 텍스트로 지정된 일반 지침을 모델이 따르는 정도를 세밀하게 수치적으로 제어할 수 있는 '조종 가능한 언어 모델'을 연구합니다. 기존 접근 방식의 한계를 극복합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM이 사용자 지시를 세밀하게 따르도록 제어하는 DIAL 프레임워크는 개인화된 AI 서비스 개발 및 특정 작업 요구사항 충족에 중요한 기술입니다.

items.title: Conservative Meta-Agent Search: Architecture Adaptation under Non-Stationarity
items.body: Automated agentic-system design is typically evaluated on static task suites with immediate scalar rewards. Deployed systems face persistent shift, delayed dependent feedback, correlated component failures, and costly architecture changes. We formalize meta-agent architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and hard risk constraints and introduce Conservative Meta-Agent Search (CMAS). CMAS retrieves archived architectures and proposes typed graph edits, then scores each against the incumbent by paired shadow replay under common random numbers, with interventional component credit. Promotion requires an empirically calibrated, variance-penalized simultaneous score above a pre-specified margin, and is followed by a simulated canary stage and pre-specified rollback. Since backtests cannot certify meta-level skill, we introduce MetaInvest-Bench, a regime-switching simulator whose specified worker competence makes a surrogate-optimal architecture computable, with leakage-controlled replay, adversarial governance tracks, and five negative controls. Financial streams serve as a risk-sensitive testbed for meta-level generalization; we claim no alpha. Across 96 streams, CMAS cuts normalized mean surrogate dynamic-oracle regret from 0.116 to 0.104 and raises held-out utility from 0.44 to 0.48 over the strongest adaptive baseline; when extra workers add no value, it contracts to near-single-agent teams. Its deployment inference cost is ~6% lower, though its search-inclusive token cost is the highest of the methods compared. The observed per-update false-promotion rate is 3.4% against a nominal 5% target, and 4.8% in a sealed rerun. The calibration is empirical: it concerns an update-level replay statistic on an author-designed benchmark, and guarantees neither full-utility improvement, nor absence of simulated canary-stage harm, nor sequence-level error control.
items.title_ko: 보수적 메타 에이전트 검색: 비정상 상태에서의 아키텍처 적응
items.summary_ko: 자동화된 에이전트 시스템 설계는 일반적으로 정적인 작업 스위트와 즉각적인 스칼라 보상으로 평가됩니다. 이 논문은 실제 시스템이 지속적인 변화, 지연된 피드백, 상호 연관된 구성 요소 실패, 비용이 많이 드는 아키텍처 변경에 직면한다는 점을 지적하며, '보수적 메타 에이전트 검색(CMAS)'을 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: 변화하는 환경에 적응하고 비용을 고려하며 위험을 최소화하는 에이전트 아키텍처 설계는 복잡한 실제 환경에 AI 시스템을 배포하는 데 필수적입니다.

items.title: Drift Says When, Budget Says How Much: Rate-Controlled KV Re-selection for Long-Form Multimodal Generation
items.body: KV cache compression for multimodal LLMs usually selects the visual tokens to keep once, at prefill, and reuses that selection for the whole generation. We show that this one-shot selection is severely limited on long-form generation: on detailed image description, even an oracle that selects with the attention of the uncompressed answer reaches only 0.44-0.52 ROUGE-L agreement with the uncompressed output, because the evidence the model reads moves as the description unfolds. Re-selecting whenever attention drifts out of the kept set is the natural remedy, but we find that a fixed drift threshold fails systematically: drift magnitudes are not comparable across samples, so low-drift samples are almost never refreshed although they benefit the most. We propose Rate-Controlled Refresh (RCR), which lets drift decide when and where to re-select while a per-sample controller regulates how often, combined with a low-rank drift detector, candidate-restricted re-selection, and a decision that stays on the GPU. With one setting for all models and tasks, RCR outperforms the per-step retrieval method InfiniGen by 1.6-3.8 ROUGE-L points on five of six model-task settings with no significant difference on the sixth, while staying within 1.7 points of exact per-step re-selection, with comparable estimated data movement per step and a 4x smaller GPU-resident detector. On DetailCaps, drift-chosen timing beats random timing at the same refresh rate and periodic timing even at a higher rate, by 2.0-5.0 points. On pre-registered video description, where drift is homogeneous across samples, RCR is on par with InfiniGen on Qwen2-VL and exceeds it on Qwen3-VL but no longer beats a fixed threshold at the nearest tested rates, consistent with the diagnosis; object-level evaluation shows that RCR achieves higher object F1 against the uncompressed output than InfiniGen on two of three models.
items.title_ko: 드리프트는 언제, 예산은 얼마나: 장문 멀티모달 생성을 위한 Rate-Controlled KV 재선택
items.summary_ko: 멀티모달 LLM을 위한 KV 캐시 압축은 일반적으로 한 번 시각 토큰을 선택하고 전체 생성에 재사용하지만, 장문 생성에서는 심각한 한계가 있습니다. 이 논문은 모델이 읽는 증거가 설명이 진행됨에 따라 이동하기 때문에, 압축되지 않은 답변의 어텐션으로 선택하는 오라클조차도 압축되지 않은 출력과의 ROUGE-L 일치도가 낮다는 것을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 장문 멀티모달 생성에서 KV 캐시를 효율적으로 관리하는 기술은 모델의 처리 속도와 생성 품질을 동시에 개선하는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: Dimension-free regimes for unadjusted Langevin in ridge-separable models: A subspace robust Wasserstein analysis
items.body: The Unadjusted Langevin Algorithm (ULA) is widely used for high-dimensional Bayesian inference. Classical analyses in Wasserstein-2 distance predict an asymptotic bias and a mixing time that grow with dimension, but this metric is stronger than necessary for many statistical tasks. We instead analyze the bias in subspace robust Wasserstein distance, which controls the mean and arbitrary low-dimensional marginals and is therefore well suited to observables typically estimated in practice. For ridge-separable potentials formed with i.i.d. data, we prove high-probability bounds showing a bell-shaped mixing profile as the number of data points $N$ varies relative to the dimension $d$. In the overparameterized regime, the effective dimension is the rank $N$ of the data-dependent perturbation, leading to complexity depending on $N$ rather than $d$. In the large-sample regime, Gaussian-perturbation estimates yield dimension-free complexity once $N$ is sufficiently large. In contrast, near the proportional regime $\asymp d$, we prove that dimension-free guarantees are impossible in general.
items.title_ko: Ridge-separable 모델에서 조정되지 않은 랑주뱅의 차원-자유 영역: 부분 공간 강건한 Wasserstein 분석
items.summary_ko: 조정되지 않은 랑주뱅 알고리즘(ULA)은 고차원 베이지안 추론에 널리 사용됩니다. Wasserstein-2 거리에서의 고전적 분석은 차원에 따라 증가하는 점근적 편향과 혼합 시간을 예측하지만, 이 논문은 부분 공간 강건한 Wasserstein 거리에서의 편향을 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 고차원 베이지안 추론에서 랑주뱅 알고리즘의 수렴 속도와 정확성을 개선하는 이론적 분석은 복잡한 확률 모델을 다루는 연구자에게 중요합니다.

items.title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
items.body: World action models increasingly rely on pretrained video models assumed to capture physical dynamics for prediction, planning, and action generation. Existing evaluations assess plausibility, probe representations, or measure predictive surprise, but rarely identify which history-conditioned physical expectations conflict with observations. We introduce PhysTrace, a training-free framework aligning MLLM-generated, history-conditioned expectations with observed video windows to temporally localize physical violations and provide interpretable descriptions without task-specific probes or classifiers. We also introduce IntPhys2-Timing, adding violation intervals to IntPhys2. PhysTrace achieves a Hit Rate of up to 70.7% across physical principles on IntPhys2-Timing and outperforms the compared methods in overall possible-impossible discrimination accuracy on IntPhys2. Applied to reconstructed videos along the trajectories of pretrained diffusion/flow-based video models, PhysTrace reveals attribute- and noise-dependent patterns in physical violation localization, enabling interpretable physical consistency analysis across timesteps.
items.title_ko: PhysTrace: 비디오 생성 모델의 물리적 일관성 해석 가능한 시간 평가
items.summary_ko: 세계 액션 모델은 예측, 계획, 액션 생성을 위해 물리적 역학을 포착한다고 가정되는 사전 훈련된 비디오 모델에 점점 더 의존합니다. 이 논문은 훈련 없이 MLLM 생성, 기록 조건화 기대치와 관찰된 비디오 창을 정렬하여 시간적으로 물리적 불일치를 지역화하는 PhysTrace 프레임워크를 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: 비디오 생성 모델이 물리적 일관성을 얼마나 잘 유지하는지 해석하고 평가하는 것은 사실적인 영상 생성 및 로봇 제어와 같은 실제 애플리케이션의 신뢰도를 높이는 데 필수적입니다.

items.title: Predictable performance is suboptimal, and what it means for model routing
items.body: Large language models (LLMs) differ in capabilities and costs, motivating routing methods that adaptively choose a model for each query. These methods rely on performance prediction: given a query, estimate whether a model will answer it correctly. Most routing methods train separate predictors of candidate models' performance to guide model selection. Our work shows that performance prediction only beats a simple baseline when the candidate model is suboptimal on the task or the performance predictor adds significant capacity relative to the candidate model. Specifically, we take a model's self-confidence, the probability it assigns to its chosen answer, as a baseline and study how much a performance predictor can improve on it. First, we show that any performance predictor that outperforms a model's self-confidence can be used to improve the model's loss: the predictor's advantage transfers exactly in log loss through recalibration. Second, accounting for the predictor's additional parameters, we bound its advantage by the model's suboptimality plus the gain from those parameters. Third, we extend our theoretical results to two-model cascades, which route queries to a more capable model when the first model is predicted to fail. Experiments with 16 language models on four benchmarks show that predictors gain a larger advantage over self-confidence on more suboptimal models. This advantage shrinks as models improve through finetuning. Cascading exhibits the same two patterns: predictor-based routing offers larger gains over confidence-based routing for more suboptimal models, and these gains diminish after finetuning.
items.title_ko: 예측 가능한 성능은 최적이 아니며, 모델 라우팅에 미치는 영향
items.summary_ko: 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)은 능력과 비용이 다르므로, 각 쿼리에 대해 모델을 적응적으로 선택하는 라우팅 방법이 필요합니다. 대부분의 라우팅 방법은 성능 예측에 의존하지만, 이 연구는 성능 예측이 간단한 기준선을 능가하는 경우는 후보 모델이 작업에 대해 최적이 아니거나 성능 예측기가 매우 정확할 때뿐임을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 모델 라우팅 전략의 한계를 이해하고 최적의 성능 예측 모델을 개발하는 것은 다중 LLM 시스템의 효율성과 비용 절감에 직접적인 영향을 미칩니다.

items.title: FocusVLA: Future-Intent Guided Dynamic View Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.body: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have become an important paradigm for robotic manipulation by unifying visual perception, language understanding, and action generation. Since reliable manipulation requires sufficient observation of objects, end-effectors, and their spatial relationships, multi-view inputs are widely used to provide complementary spatial information. However, our experiments show that existing VLA models do not fully exploit such multi-view complementarity. The policy tends to persistently rely on the wrist view, lacking the ability to dynamically adjust global-local view dependency across manipulation stages, which limits stage adaptability and robustness. To address this issue, we propose FocusVLA, a stage-aware multi-view routing framework. FocusVLA predicts future interaction intent from historical actions and uses it to guide dynamic view routing during action generation. By adaptively coordinating global and local observations across different task stages, FocusVLA improves multi-view utilization. On RoboTwin 2.0, FocusVLA improves the average success rate over the strongest baseline $π_{0.5}$ by 10.10 pp. In real-world evaluation, FocusVLA improves the success rate from 71.7\% to 85.0\%, achieving a 13.3\% gain over $π_{0.5}$. Moreover, the intent prediction and dynamic routing modules of FocusVLA can be integrated into existing VLA frameworks without modifying their core architectures.
items.title_ko: FocusVLA: 미래 의도 가이드 동적 뷰 라우팅을 위한 Vision-Language-Action 모델
items.summary_ko: Vision-language-action (VLA) 모델은 시각적 인식, 언어 이해, 행동 생성을 통합하여 로봇 조작을 위한 중요한 패러다임이 되었습니다. 이 논문은 기존 VLA 모델이 멀티뷰 입력의 보완성을 완전히 활용하지 못하며, 정책이 객체, 엔드 이펙터 및 공간 관계의 충분한 관찰을 필요로 한다는 점을 지적합니다. 미래 의도를 가이드로 사용하는 새로운 동적 뷰 라우팅을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇 조작에서 다중 시점 정보를 효율적으로 활용하는 VLA 모델은 복잡한 실제 환경에서 로봇의 정밀성과 신뢰성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: How Well Do Decision Models Transfer to Vietnamese? An Empirical Study of Text Classification
items.body: Recent advances in specialized decision models have expanded the possibilities for zero-shot classification, yet their effectiveness on Vietnamese remains underexplored. This study evaluates four specialized decision models across 13 classification settings spanning six task groups, examining zero-shot performance, sensitivity to label-description language, and robustness to Vietnamese linguistic variations. The evaluation considers English, Vietnamese, and bilingual label descriptions, alongside common linguistic perturbations involving teencode, typographical errors, and diacritic removal. Under English label descriptions, JEV achieves the strongest overall performance, ranking first in 11 classification settings. The effects of label-description language vary across models and datasets, with bilingual descriptions providing no consistent improvement. Robustness experiments reveal that diacritic removal causes the most substantial performance degradation, reducing mean macro-$F_1$ by 9.51--15.47 points across model configurations, considerably more than teencode or typographical errors. These findings highlight the importance of label-description choices and Vietnamese orthographic variation when evaluating specialized decision models for zero-shot text classification.
items.title_ko: 베트남어에 대한 의사결정 모델 전이성 연구: 텍스트 분류 실증 연구
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 전문화된 의사결정 모델의 제로샷 분류 능력이 베트남어에서 얼마나 효과적인지 탐구합니다. 13개 분류 설정과 6개 작업 그룹에서 4가지 모델을 평가하며, 레이블 설명 언어에 대한 민감도와 베트남어 언어 변형에 대한 강건성을 조사합니다.
items.why_ko: 저자원 언어에 대한 LLM의 전이 학습 및 제로샷 성능 평가는 다국어 AI 시스템 개발 및 언어 다양성 지원에 중요합니다.

items.title: How Depth Growth and Looping Shape In-Context Learning in Language Models
items.body: Looped and depth-grown language models reuse computations across depth and have attracted interest for their reasoning capabilities. Building on prior suggestive evidence of improved in-context-learning (ICL), we investigate how such reuse favors ICL, including how it shapes the acquisition, retention, and mechanisms of this ability. Our analysis spans pretrained language models up to 3B parameters and controlled tasks. The experiments provide evidence for a shared inductive bias toward learning from context: grown and looped models rely more on information in context and, compared with a full-depth dense reference, acquire ICL earlier in controlled tasks and retain it more strongly when learning fixed associations in the weights is also possible. Tracing attention heads through training reveals that depth growth propagates early induction heads across layers. Ablations show that grown and looped models rely more strongly on induction-ranked heads for both few-shot performance and later-token prediction. Together, these findings provide evidence for a shared inductive bias toward learning from context and suggest that (soft) parameter reuse shapes how this ability develops and which attention mechanisms support it.
items.title_ko: 깊이 성장 및 루핑이 언어 모델의 In-Context Learning에 미치는 영향
items.summary_ko: 루프드(Looped) 및 깊이 성장(depth-grown) 언어 모델은 깊이에 걸쳐 계산을 재사용하며 추론 능력으로 주목받고 있습니다. 이 논문은 이러한 재사용이 In-Context Learning (ICL)에 어떻게 영향을 미치는지, 특히 ICL 능력의 획득, 유지 및 메커니즘을 어떻게 형성하는지 조사합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 아키텍처적 특성(깊이 성장, 루핑)이 인컨텍스트 학습 능력에 미치는 영향을 이해하는 것은 모델 설계 및 성능 향상에 중요한 통찰력을 제공합니다.

items.title: Post-Hoc Feature Selection Layer for Neural Networks Interpretability
items.body: The interpretability of complex neural networks remains a critical challenge, especially for models already deployed in high-stakes domains. To address this, we adapted the Feature Selection Layer (FSL) to optimize feature weights post-training, a variant we term post-hoc FSL. Our approach reframes the FSL as a lightweight, trainable module that integrates with already frozen pre-trained models on tabular datasets to highlight the features the original model considers most important. This post-hoc FSL learns feature relevance by fine-tuning its weights based on the original model's learned outputs. Crucially, this process is non-invasive, operating without altering the original model's architecture or its learned parameters. We conducted our experiments using both statistical and visual metrics, including accuracy, F1 score, recall, precision, weighted t-SNE and silhouette score, and also analyzed the stability of the post-hoc FSL on high-dimensional synthetic and real-world tabular datasets. We compared the post-hoc FSL feature weighting method using these metrics against the original embedded FSL and other post-hoc interpretability methods, such as Integrated Gradients, Noise Tunnel, DeepLIFT, Gradient SHAP, and Feature Ablation. Experimental results demonstrate that the post-hoc FSL feature weighting method successfully identified relevant features across the different datasets, maintaining the predictive power of the original neural network while enhancing its interpretability.
items.title_ko: 신경망 해석 가능성을 위한 Post-Hoc 특징 선택 계층
items.summary_ko: 복잡한 신경망의 해석 가능성은 여전히 중요한 과제입니다. 이 논문은 Post-hoc FSL(Feature Selection Layer)을 제안하며, 훈련 후 특징 가중치를 최적화하여 이미 배포된 사전 훈련 모델에 통합하여 원래 모델이 가장 중요하게 고려하는 특징을 강조합니다.
items.why_ko: 배포된 신경망 모델의 예측을 사후적으로 설명하고 핵심 특징을 식별하는 기술은 AI 시스템의 투명성과 신뢰성을 높이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: SyRA-CS: Synthetic-to-Real Adaptation for Code-Switched ASR with Meta-Learning
items.body: Code-switched (CS) automatic speech recognition (ASR) remains difficult because real CS speech is scarce and synthetic speech does not fully match it. We investigate whether synthetic CS speech is more useful for learning an adaptation-friendly initialization than for ordinary continual fine-tuning. We propose SyRA-CS, a pair-specific synthetic-to-real adaptation framework based on Reptile meta-learning. For each language pair and pretrained model, we meta-train on the corresponding synthetic CS-FLEURS subset and then adapt using one hour of labeled real target speech. We evaluate four architectural settings: Encoder-CTC, FastConformer-RNN-T, Attention Encoder-Decoder (AED) and Speech-LLM. Experiments cover on Arabic-, French-, German-, and Hindi-English, against synthetic-only transfer, real-only fine-tuning, and continual fine-tuning. SyRA-CS improves over continual fine-tuning on WER in all 16 model-pair comparisons and on CER in 15 of 16, with relative macro WER reductions of 17.7% for XLS-R and 5.3-5.8% for the other three models. The gains hold across the tested models but vary in size across architectures, language pairs and metrics.
items.title_ko: SyRA-CS: 메타 학습을 이용한 코드 전환 ASR의 합성-실제 적응
items.summary_ko: 코드 전환(CS) 자동 음성 인식(ASR)은 실제 CS 음성이 부족하고 합성 음성이 완벽하게 일치하지 않아 여전히 어렵습니다. 이 논문은 합성 CS 음성이 일반적인 연속 미세 조정보다 적응 친화적인 초기화를 학습하는 데 더 유용한지 조사하며, Reptile 메타 학습 기반의 'SyRA-CS' 프레임워크를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 저자원 언어 및 복잡한 언어 현상인 코드 전환에 대한 ASR 성능 향상은 다국어 음성 AI 시스템의 실제 적용 가능성을 넓히는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: Major Revision, Minor Accountability: LLMs as Reviewers of Published Articles in Top-Tier Journals
items.body: With the growth of scientific output, the peer review system is approaching a breaking point: reviewers are increasingly hard to secure, and turnaround times lengthen accordingly. LLM-assisted or LLM-generated peer review has been proposed as a remedy, but how such models would treat manuscripts already published in top-tier journals, the closest thing the current system has to a gold standard of scientific validity, is not known. Here we assembled a corpus of 200 articles, each released under a CC BY 4.0 license and published in 2026, from 20 general-science, life-science, and clinical-medicine journals including Nature, Science, and Cell, and asked four current LLMs (two proprietary, two open-weight) to produce independent peer-review reports of each one under a blinded protocol. Their decisions were overwhelmingly harsh and starkly inconsistent with each other: 605 of 800 reviews (75.6%) recommended major revision or rejection, but the rate at which any single model did so ranged from 17.5% to 100% (p < 0.001), disagreement on manuscripts that had, by construction, already survived real editorial review at the journals in question. When the same manuscripts were doctored with one deliberately planted, field-specific methodological or statistical flaw, detection rates varied from 17.0% to 60.5% across models (p < 0.001). Recommending revision for papers that had already passed editorial review (low specificity) while missing flaws deliberately placed in front of them (low sensitivity), these models produce output that should be read for what it is: an uneven, framing- and model-dependent signal.
items.title_ko: 주요 저널 출판 논문 검토자로서의 LLM: 주요 개정, 사소한 책임
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 과학적 생산량 증가로 동료 검토 시스템이 한계에 도달하고 있음을 지적하며, LLM 지원 또는 LLM 생성 동료 검토가 해결책으로 제안됩니다. 이미 최고 수준 저널에 출판된 논문에 대해 LLM이 어떻게 평가하는지 200개 논문 코퍼스를 통해 조사했습니다.
items.why_ko: LLM이 학술 논문 심사에 활용될 가능성과 그에 따른 윤리적, 과학적 타당성 문제는 AI가 전문 분야에 미치는 영향에 대한 중요한 논의를 촉발합니다.

items.title: SQuAT: Spherical Lattice Vector Quantization-Aware Training
items.body: Vector quantization (VQ), in particular lattice-based methods, offer strong rate-distortion trade-offs for low-bit large language models (LLMs), yet their behavior under quantization-aware training (VQ-QAT) remains poorly understood. We scale lattice VQ-QAT to billion-parameter LLMs and multi-billion-token training regimes, and introduce SQuAT, a shape-gain VQ-QAT approach trained with a separate straight-through estimator (STE) for the shape and gain. SQuAT decomposes weights into direction and magnitude: normalized directions are quantized using an $E_8$-derived spherical codebook, while gains are quantized independently with low-bit scalar quantizers. We show that, unlike a standard STE applied to the full quantizer, which ignores the shape-gain structure, these separate STEs induce tangent-space updates for directions, yielding an implicit form of spherical (Riemannian) optimization. To enable scalability, we develop a distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment scheme, in which workers quantize disjoint weight blocks and communicate only discrete indices, reducing VQ-QAT training time by 12.8$\times$ and allowing us to scale it to 10B tokens. Across instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, Qwen3-4B, and base Qwen3-1.7B, SQuAT consistently outperforms standard VQ-QAT STE under identical quantizers and initialization, and achieves SOTA VQ-QAT accuracy.
items.title_ko: SQuAT: 구형 격자 벡터 양자화 인식 훈련
items.summary_ko: 벡터 양자화(VQ), 특히 격자 기반 방법은 저비트 대규모 언어 모델(LLM)에 강력한 속도-왜곡 트레이드오프를 제공하지만, 양자화 인식 훈련(VQ-QAT) 하에서의 동작은 잘 알려져 있지 않습니다. 이 논문은 격자 VQ-QAT를 수십억 매개변수 LLM과 수십억 토큰 훈련 체제로 확장하고, SQuAT를 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 양자화 및 압축 기술은 모델의 배포 효율성을 극대화하고, 제한된 하드웨어에서도 대규모 AI 모델을 활용할 수 있게 하는 핵심 기술입니다.

items.title: Same Entity, Different Script: Diagnosing Cross-Script Entity Matching Failures in Language Models
items.body: Multilingual language models can give different identity judgments when the same people's names are written in different scripts. We study this effect using 601 audited identity pairs with attested Devanagari and Latin forms, holding the question and relation fixed. Qwen2.5-7B's same-person accuracy falls from 35.1% in Latin to 8.5% in Devanagari under Marathi prompts, while different-person accuracy remains above 98%. Evaluation across five models reveals distinct response biases, and reduced tokenization fragmentation does not reliably close the gap. Replicating the design on 374 audited Malayalam pairs built from the same entities reproduces the effect in a second script and language family: same-person accuracy falls to 5.3%, about half the matched Devanagari rate, while the margin still ranks matching above non-matching names at 0.925 AUROC. Latin-trained probes recover label information from Devanagari states, exceeding a string-feature baseline under similarity-matched negatives. Scalar calibration recovers 87% of the raw model-probe balanced-accuracy gap, identifying decision criterion placement as a major contributor. Activation patching localises causal sensitivity to the second entity in Qwen's middle layers; one shared sensitivity direction transfers about half the full-state margin correction. A fact-independent intervention at this site raises held-out Marathi same-person accuracy from 6.5% to 33.5%, with 98.5% different-person accuracy. Together, these results distinguish script-dependent discrimination from criterion placement and identify a causal site for improving identity judgments.
items.title_ko: 동일 엔티티, 다른 스크립트: 언어 모델에서 교차 스크립트 엔티티 매칭 실패 진단
items.summary_ko: 다국어 언어 모델은 동일한 사람의 이름이 다른 스크립트로 작성될 때 다른 식별 판단을 내릴 수 있습니다. 이 논문은 601개의 감사된 데바나가리 및 라틴어 형태의 신원 쌍을 사용하여 이 효과를 연구하며, Qwen2.5-7B가 마라티 프롬프트에서 라틴어 정확도 35.1%에서 데바나가리 8.5%로 떨어진다는 것을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 다국어 LLM에서 교차 스크립트 엔티티 매칭의 실패는 다국어 정보 처리의 심각한 한계를 보여주며, 글로벌 AI 애플리케이션 개발에 중요한 고려사항입니다.

items.title: AgentPhishing: A Benchmark of LLM Email Agents Under Adaptive Attack
items.body: Computer-use agents increasingly handle private information and act on users' behalf across desktop and web applications, including email. Phishing therefore poses privacy and security risks that depend not only on whether agents recognize malicious messages, but also on how they respond. Existing phishing datasets were developed primarily for conventional detection, leaving agent susceptibility to persuasive malicious requests insufficiently characterized. To expose vulnerabilities that pre-existing datasets may miss, we introduce AgentPhishing, a benchmark for evaluating whether persuasive phishing attacks can evade detection and induce LLM email agents to comply with malicious requests. We develop PhishOpt, which optimizes reusable email-generation skills against individual agents under fixed benchmark constraints and a realism constraint. We analyze the generated emails using Cialdini's persuasion principles to identify strategies associated with agent failures and use these findings to construct a universal generation skill. Our evaluation shows that agents can handle pre-existing phishing emails safely yet remain susceptible to attacks adapted to agent behavior, while in an AgentPhishing evaluation of nine agents, four exhibit phishing-detection rates below $10\%$ and malicious-request compliance rates above $45\%$. These results highlight the limits of inferring agent safety from conventional phishing evaluations and the need to assess how agents respond to persuasive malicious requests.
items.body_ko: 컴퓨터 사용 에이전트는 이메일을 포함한 데스크톱 및 웹 애플리케이션 전반에서 개인 정보를 처리하고 사용자를 대신하여 작업하는 경우가 늘고 있습니다. 따라서 피싱은 에이전트가 악성 메시지를 인식하는지 여부뿐만 아니라 에이전트가 어떻게 반응하는지에 따라 프라이버시 및 보안 위험을 초래합니다. 기존 피싱 데이터셋은 주로 전통적인 탐지를 위해 개발되었으며, 설득력 있는 악성 요청에 대한 에이전트의 취약성을 충분히 특성화하지 못했습니다. 기존 데이터셋이 놓칠 수 있는 취약점을 노출하기 위해, 우리는 설득력 있는 피싱 공격이 탐지를 회피하고 LLM 이메일 에이전트가 악성 요청을 준수하도록 유도할 수 있는지 평가하기 위한 벤치마크인 AgentPhishing을 소개합니다. 우리는 고정된 벤치마크 제약 조건과 현실성 제약 조건 하에서 개별 에이전트에 대해 재사용 가능한 이메일 생성 기술을 최적화하는 PhishOpt를 개발합니다. 우리는 Cialdini의 설득 원칙을 사용하여 생성된 이메일을 분석하여 에이전트 실패와 관련된 전략을 식별하고, 이러한 발견을 사용하여 범용 생성 기술을 구축합니다. 우리의 평가는 에이전트가 기존 피싱 이메일을 안전하게 처리할 수 있지만 에이전트 행동에 맞춰 조정된 공격에는 여전히 취약하다는 것을 보여줍니다. AgentPhishing 평가에서 9개 에이전트 중 4개는 피싱 탐지율이 10% 미만이고 악성 요청 준수율이 45% 이상을 보였습니다. 이러한 결과는 전통적인 피싱 평가에서 에이전트 안전을 추론하는 것의 한계와 에이전트가 설득력 있는 악성 요청에 어떻게 반응하는지 평가할 필요성을 강조합니다.
items.title_ko: AgentPhishing: 적응형 공격 하의 LLM 이메일 에이전트 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: 컴퓨터 사용 에이전트는 이메일을 포함한 데스크톱 및 웹 애플리케이션 전반에 걸쳐 개인 정보를 처리하고 사용자를 대신하여 행동합니다. 피싱은 에이전트가 악성 메시지를 인식하는지뿐만 아니라 어떻게 반응하는지에 따라 프라이버시 및 보안 위험을 초래합니다. 이 논문은 기존의 탐지 중심 데이터셋으로는 에이전트의 취약성을 충분히 특성화할 수 없다고 지적하며, 'AgentPhishing' 벤치마크를 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 에이전트의 피싱 공격 취약성에 대한 벤치마크는 AI 기반 보안 시스템의 한계를 명확히 하고, 더욱 견고한 에이전트 보안 메커니즘을 개발하는 데 필수적입니다.

items.title: HERD: Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation for Continual Learning
items.body: Continual learning requires a model to keep acquiring new skills and knowledge without compromising its existing capabilities. Parametric methods suffer from catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity. Non-parametric methods, such as prompts, skills, and harnesses, leverage in-context learning but are limited by context length and lossy plain-text compression. To effectively combine their complementary strengths, we propose HERD (Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation), a hybrid continual learning framework that learns efficiently in the harness and internalizes experience into cumulative capabilities via distillation. On the harness side, HERD continually refines its skills to capture reusable patterns, while retaining high-residual examples that the skills fail to capture in a bounded memory. On the parameter side, HERD performs drift-constrained distillation with dual anchors, substantially reducing forgetting over long recursive runs. On the 25-stage task stream of TRACE+17, under fixed memory and compute budgets, HERD matches the strongest parametric baseline in new-task acquisition while exhibiting the least forgetting and the strongest retention of general capabilities.
items.title_ko: HERD: 지속 학습을 위한 Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation
items.summary_ko: 지속 학습은 모델이 기존 능력을 손상시키지 않으면서 새로운 기술과 지식을 계속 습득하도록 요구합니다. 이 논문은 매개변수 방법의 '치명적 망각'과 비매개변수 방법의 한계를 지적하며, 이들의 상호 보완적인 강점을 효과적으로 결합하기 위한 하이브리드 지속 학습 프레임워크인 HERD (Harness-Evolving Recursive Distillation)를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 치명적 망각 문제를 해결하고 모델의 유연성을 유지하며 지속적으로 학습하는 능력은 실제 환경에 배포되는 AI 시스템에 필수적입니다.

items.title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Large Language Models to a Low-Resource Agglutinative Language: A Corpus, Datasets, and a Reproducible Benchmark for the Bashkir Language
items.body: Bashkir is a low-resource agglutinative language written in Cyrillic and remains poorly represented in modern LLMs. We present an open resource suite and a systematic benchmark of adaptation methods: the Bashkir Web Corpus (71,567 documents, 46.9M tokens, 16 sources) and three labelled datasets for binary, multiclass and multilabel text classification; the benchmark covers the first two. Experiments use eight architectures (82M-8B: DistilGPT2, GPT-2 base/medium, Phi-3-mini, Mistral-7B, YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B, mBERT, XLM-R) and three adaptation groups (full fine-tuning, QLoRA, in-context learning), plus continual pretraining (CPT). (1) QLoRA on 3.8-8B models outperforms encoder-only fine-tuning on binary classification: YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B with CPT reaches macro-F1 0.748 vs 0.653 (XLM-R) and 0.650 (mBERT); pairwise differences are significant after Holm correction (p<0.001). (2) YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B significantly outperforms Mistral-7B and Phi-3-mini on multiclass classification, BPB and native-speaker ratings (mean 3.28 vs 2.52 and 2.22; n=100; alpha=0.69-0.77; p<0.05); on binary classification its QLoRA advantage is not significant (p>=0.084). (3) CPT effects depend on model and task: perplexity improves for Phi-3-mini (+0.58) and YandexGPT-5-Lite-8B (+0.33) but worsens for Mistral-7B (-1.15, p<0.001); on binary classification CPT helps Mistral-7B most (+4.0 macro-F1). (4) Tokeniser fertility on Bashkir varies 2.67x (2.92-7.80) and tracks adaptation quality, while perplexity across tokenisers is not comparable. Cyrillic tokenisers with Russian pretraining are preferable; LLM judges reproduce native ratings for grammar and coherence (rho=0.33-0.46) but not language correctness (rho=0.16, p=0.11); native evaluation remains necessary. All artefacts are open-licensed.
items.title_ko: 저자원 교착어에 대한 LLM의 효율적인 매개변수 적응: 바시키르어를 위한 코퍼스, 데이터셋 및 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: 바시키르어는 키릴 문자를 사용하는 저자원 교착어로, 현대 LLM에서 잘 표현되지 않습니다. 이 논문은 바시키르 웹 코퍼스(71,567개 문서, 46.9M 토큰)와 이진, 다중 클래스, 다중 레이블 텍스트 분류를 위한 세 가지 레이블 데이터셋을 포함하는 오픈 리소스 스위트를 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 저자원 언어에 대한 LLM의 성능을 개선하고 평가하기 위한 공개 자원 및 벤치마크는 언어 다양성을 지원하고, 전 세계 사용자를 위한 AI 접근성을 높이는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: Auditing the Hand-Written Inputs of Learned Access Control
items.body: Learned access control is typically deployed behind two hand-built artefacts: a hard-deny set enforced by a small trusted shield, and a region map that decides which requests mined rules answer and which the learner answers. Verifying the shield or measuring the learner validates neither. We audit both on the five public ABAC Lab policies. First, we formalise hard-deny soundness and check it exhaustively over relations of up to 794,250 tuples. Clauses that faithfully transcribe an explicit restriction are unsound at rates of 0.50-0.70 across four elicitors - an author and three blind language-model elicitors - because prose scopes restrictions to a section while the grant relation is a disjunction over all rules: 97% of counterexamples are granted by other rules. Shipped unchecked, these deny sets would withhold 16-78% of everything the policies grant; certified, they withhold nothing. Vacuity, a second silent failure, also occurs. Second, hybrid routing needs a two-class, abstaining rule set that ABAC miners do not emit, and ranking a mixed-effect candidate pool under a cap is one-class in all 24 cells for the two commonest ranking keys. Third, for additive losses the hybrid-versus-learner effect factorises into covered mass times a rule-learner risk contrast that must be reported on both false-non-grant and false-permit loss: on two real policies, most selection rules give opposite verdicts on the two losses, and the one favourable on both holds for one policy, one learner configuration and a band of noise levels. A released artefact regenerates and checks every reported number.
items.title_ko: 학습된 접근 제어의 수동 입력 감사
items.summary_ko: 학습된 접근 제어는 일반적으로 두 가지 수동으로 구축된 아티팩트(하드 거부 세트, 영역 맵) 뒤에 배포됩니다. 이 논문은 다섯 가지 공개 ABAC Lab 정책에 대해 이 두 가지를 모두 감사합니다. 첫째, 하드 거부 건전성을 공식화하고 최대 794,250개 튜플 관계에 대해 철저히 확인합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기반 접근 제어 시스템의 보안 취약점을 감사하고 검증하는 것은 시스템의 신뢰성과 안전성을 보장하는 데 필수적인 실무 지식입니다.

items.title: Convex Equilibrium Potentials for Monge--Ampère: Curvature Bounds and A Posteriori Evaluation
items.body: Equilibrium neural networks define their hidden state as the fixed point of a contraction, so their effective depth is set at evaluation time rather than by the architecture. Using them for fully nonlinear PDEs raises two issues that explicit networks avoid: second derivatives may grow with the effective depth, and the potential is only ever evaluated approximately. We study nonnegative softplus equilibrium networks with contraction factor $q<1$, a convex class suited to the Monge--Ampère equation. A positivity cancellation in the resolvent shows that the Hessian grows at most like $(1-q)^{-2}$, rather than the $(1-q)^{-3}$ of a direct estimate, and an explicit one-neuron family shows that this exponent is sharp; third derivatives satisfy a sharp $(1-q)^{-3}$ bound. Residual-based a posteriori estimates then control the state, its input derivatives and, in two dimensions, the Hessian determinant at an approximate equilibrium. Combined with interval arithmetic on complete covers of the domain, they yield rigorous uniform bounds on the Monge--Ampère residual and, through a comparison argument, on the solution error of a fixed trained network. On two manufactured Dirichlet problems on the unit disk, all six trained models are certified with residual below $0.25$ and boundary error below $0.01$. Adaptive stopping halves float64 evaluation time at best, whereas certified adaptive evaluation remains costlier than fixed depth.
items.title_ko: Monge-Ampère를 위한 볼록 평형 포텐셜: 곡률 경계 및 사후 평가
items.summary_ko: 평형 신경망은 은닉 상태를 수축의 고정점으로 정의하므로, 효과적인 깊이가 아키텍처가 아닌 평가 시점에 설정됩니다. 이 논문은 완전 비선형 편미분 방정식(PDE)에 이를 사용할 때 발생하는 두 가지 문제를 연구합니다: 유효 깊이에 따른 2차 도함수 증가와 포텐셜의 근사 평가 문제입니다.
items.why_ko: PDE 해결에 신경망을 활용하는 것은 과학 컴퓨팅 분야에서 새로운 가능성을 열지만, 그 한계와 특성을 이해하는 것은 정확하고 신뢰할 수 있는 모델 개발에 중요합니다.

items.title: A Task-Centric Survey of Long-Document Visual Question Answering: Taxonomy, Evolution, and Future Directions
items.body: Visual document understanding is essential for acquiring knowledge from visually rich documents and is attracting growing research interest. Existing surveys emphasize architectures or technical approaches, with limited attention to how task bottlenecks shape technical choices and research priorities. We present a task-centric survey that decomposes long-document visual question answering (VQA) into four components: document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation. For each, we develop a fine-grained taxonomy and trace motivations, technical responses, and cross-component connections. We focus on explicit retrieval while covering direct reading. Our temporal analysis traces expanding priorities from multimodal content understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management. We outline future directions in evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination, with an outlook on continual document understanding.
items.title_ko: 장문 문서 시각 질문 답변의 작업 중심 설문조사: 분류, 진화 및 미래 방향
items.summary_ko: 시각적으로 풍부한 문서에서 지식을 얻는 데 필수적인 시각 문서 이해는 연구 관심이 높아지고 있습니다. 이 논문은 기존 연구가 아키텍처나 기술적 접근 방식에 초점을 맞추는 한계를 지적하며, 장문 문서 시각 질문 답변(VQA)을 문서 파싱, 증거 구성 및 검색, 생성기 구성 및 추론의 네 가지 구성 요소로 분해하는 작업 중심 설문조사를 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 장문 문서 VQA의 작업 중심 분석은 이 분야의 병목 현상을 식별하고, 멀티모달 LLM이 복잡한 문서 이해 작업을 더 효과적으로 수행할 수 있도록 연구 방향을 제시합니다.

items.title: AI Risk Ontologies for the EU AI Act Compliance: AIRO, VAIR, and their Integration with DPV
items.body: As the use of AI, and consequently its harms, becomes more prevalent, the global discourse around AI has become increasingly risk-aware. With new risks emerging more frequently than ever, a key challenge is how to represent, document, and catalogue AI risks in an effective, interoperable, and queryable manner. Additionally, the European Union (EU) AI Act's requirements for "high-risk" AI systems to manage and document the risks creates the need for open and interoperable tools, methods, and standards that facilitate AI risk management in an ever-changing environment. In this paper, we present ontologies and taxonomies developed to assist with risk management and documentation, in line with the requirements of the EU the AI Act. We developed the AI Risk Ontology (AIRO) to specify AI use cases and their associated risks, complemented by the Vocabulary of AI Risks (VAIR), which populates AIRO with taxonomies of concepts. Key international standards on AI and risk, namely ISO/IEC 23894 on AI risk management and ISO/IEC 22989 on AI terminology informed the development of the ontologies. To promote reuse and enable multi-regulatory compliance, AIRO and VAIR have been integrated in the Data Privacy Vocabulary (DPV) through a consensus-building process, expanding DPV's scope from data to AI.
items.body_ko: AI 사용이 증가하고 그로 인한 피해가 만연해지면서, AI에 대한 전 세계적 담론은 점차 위험을 인식하는 방향으로 바뀌고 있습니다. 그 어느 때보다 더 자주 새로운 위험이 나타나고 있는 상황에서, AI 위험을 효과적이고 상호 운용 가능하며 쿼리 가능한 방식으로 표현, 문서화 및 분류하는 방법이 핵심 과제입니다. 또한, EU AI Act의 '고위험' AI 시스템에 대한 위험 관리 및 문서화 요구 사항은 끊임없이 변화하는 환경에서 AI 위험 관리를 촉진하는 개방형 및 상호 운용 가능한 도구, 방법 및 표준의 필요성을 야기합니다. 본 논문에서는 EU AI Act의 요구 사항에 맞춰 위험 관리 및 문서화를 돕기 위해 개발된 온톨로지와 분류 체계를 제시합니다. 우리는 AI 사용 사례와 그와 관련된 위험을 명시하기 위해 AI Risk Ontology(AIRO)를 개발했으며, 이를 개념 분류 체계로 채우는 Vocabulary of AI Risks(VAIR)로 보완했습니다. AI 및 위험에 대한 주요 국제 표준, 즉 AI 위험 관리에 대한 ISO/IEC 23894와 AI 용어에 대한 ISO/IEC 22989가 온톨로지 개발에 정보를 제공했습니다. 재사용을 촉진하고 다중 규정 준수를 가능하게 하기 위해, AIRO와 VAIR은 합의 형성 과정을 통해 Data Privacy Vocabulary(DPV)에 통합되어 DPV의 범위를 데이터에서 AI로 확장했습니다.
items.title_ko: EU AI Act 준수를 위한 AI 위험 온톨로지: AIRO, VAIR 및 DPV와의 통합
items.summary_ko: AI 사용 증가와 그에 따른 피해 증가로 AI 위험에 대한 글로벌 논의가 활발해지고 있습니다. 새로운 위험이 빠르게 출현하면서 AI 위험을 효과적이고 상호 운용 가능하며 쿼리 가능한 방식으로 표현, 문서화, 분류하는 것이 중요합니다. 이 논문은 EU AI Act의 '고위험' AI 시스템 요구사항을 충족하기 위한 AI 위험 온톨로지(AIRO, VAIR) 및 DPV와의 통합을 다룹니다.
items.why_ko: EU AI Act와 같은 규제 준수를 위한 AI 위험 관리 및 문서화 프레임워크는 AI 시스템의 윤리적이고 안전한 개발 및 배포에 필수적인 도구입니다.

items.title: Certified Execution Harness for Agentic AI: Safe and Least-Intrusive Petri-Net Supervisory Control Between Reasoning and Action
items.body: This paper studies the problem of safe tool execution for large language model (LLM) agents under prompt injection. Using Petri nets, we formalize the execution harness between the LLM and its tools as a supervisory control problem, in which marks represent capabilities, approvals and budgets. Since a transition fires only if the marks it needs are present, an injected request whose preconditions are unmet or already spent is refused regardless of its wording. Treating tool outcomes as uncontrollable, we enforce safety by the conventional maximally permissive supervisor, and this safety transfers to the running system under four assumptions. Moreover, to capture an agent that may propose again after a refusal, we introduce the notion of a replanning closed loop, in which each retry costs an inference call. We show that, in this loop, the conventional supervisor can be arbitrarily more intrusive than a stricter safe one.
